title: Senior Integration Developer
location: Sacramento, CA; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Portland, OR; Austin, TX; St Louis, MO
description:
Senior Integration Developer

Are you an engineering‑minded consultant who loves diving into messy infrastructures, building what doesn’t exist, and helping clients navigate mission‑critical transformations? If so, read on!

About Us
If it’s high-stakes, high-security, or highly complex—Oxalis is built for it. We’re a consulting and technology partner for the organizations that keep the world running: life sciences, shipyards, government agencies, health systems, aerospace programs, and manufacturers with missions too critical to fail. We serve the people behind the mission—those building, healing, defending, and delivering where it matters most. As a Platinum Solution Partner for Atlassian and a trusted systems integrator for IFS, we specialize in secure cloud transformation, IT service management, ERP modernization, and Operational strategy. We focus especially on organizations navigating compliance-heavy environments and complex change.

About the Role
As a Senior Integration Developer, you will drive technical execution on complex enterprise engagements. When projects hit blockers — missing integrations, broken automations, gaps between what the platform supports and what the business needs — you solve them. That means writing scripts, building integrations from scratch, reverse-engineering configurations, and engineering your way through problems that off-the-shelf tooling can’t handle.

You will work hands-on across the full engagement lifecycle: assessing environments, identifying technical risk, closing capability gaps, and validating outcomes. Over time, that technical credibility is what earns you the role of trusted advisor and modernization partner to client stakeholders — someone who can communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly, and help organizations see a path forward when the technology gets complicated.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Execution & Problem Solving

  • Identify and resolve technical blockers across all phases of migration — from pre-migration assessment through post-cutover stabilization.
  • Reverse-engineer existing configurations, workflows, automations, and integrations to understand what must be rebuilt, replaced, or retired in the cloud.
  • Build custom tooling, scripts, and integrations where vendor-supported solutions fall short — owning the solution end to end.

Infrastructure & Systems Engineering

  • Windows and Linux environments — server administration, permissions management, service configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • SSH and remote access tooling to manage and diagnose infrastructure in hybrid and cloud environments.
  • Manage environment variables, startup scripts, daemons, and scheduled tasks across platforms.

Scripting, Automation & Development

  • Write and maintain scripts in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or comparable languages to support migration validation, data cleanup, and operational automation.
  • Build reusable accelerators and utilities that improve delivery efficiency across engagements.

Data, Integrations & APIs

  • REST and GraphQL APIs — interacting with platforms, extracting and transforming data, validating migration outcomes, and building or replacing integrations.
  • SQL — validating data integrity and migration accuracy.
  • Work with cloud-native integration patterns — webhooks, OAuth, event-driven architectures — to replace or redesign on-premises integrations.

Atlassian Platform & Migration

  • Own technical solutions and execution on Atlassian engagements — designing approaches, resolving blockers, and delivering outcomes hands-on.
  • Support Atlassian migrations by providing technical expertise alongside JCMA and CCMA tooling — stepping in where vendor solutions hit their limits.
  • Evaluate and mitigate technical risks related to scale, data integrity, performance, compliance, and user experience.
  • Plan and execute phased migrations, test migrations, cutover strategies, and rollback plans.
  • Identify and close technical gaps where Atlassian’s native capabilities, Marketplace apps, or existing integrations don’t meet business requirements — building solutions where none exist.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Translate technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs into clear, actionable guidance for both technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • Own the technical narrative on your engagements — from readiness assessments through post-migration reviews.

Pre-Sales & Practice Growth

  • Support pre-sales engagements including migration assessments, solution design, estimates, and proposal contributions.
  • Contribute to Oxalis’ migration methodologies, accelerators, and internal knowledge base.
  • Mentor consultants and share lessons learned across the practice.


About You

  • Extensive hands-on technical experience in enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated client-facing consulting experience.
  • Linux and Windows systems administration — permissions, services, startup processes, and troubleshooting.
  • SSH and remote infrastructure management in hybrid or cloud environments.
  • REST and GraphQL APIs — building, consuming, and debugging integrations.
  • Python, PowerShell, Bash, or comparable languages — writing real, working code, not just modifying samples.
  • SQL — validating data integrity across migrations.
  • Ability to communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent hands-on experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Atlassian products — Jira, Confluence, or Jira Service Management administration and configuration.
  • Exposure to Atlassian Cloud migrations and familiarity with JCMA and/or CCMA.
  • Atlassian Certified Professional or Associate certifications.
  • Experience with identity and access management — SSO, SAML, SCIM — in cloud environments.
  • Background in regulated or compliance-heavy environments (e.g., public sector, healthcare, aerospace and defense).
  • Experience with OAuth, webhooks, and event-driven integration patterns.
  • Familiarity with GraphQL tooling (e.g., Postman, Insomnia) or API gateway configurations.

Why Work for Us?
Join Oxalis and be part of a team that’s transforming how regulated industries operate through cutting-edge solutions. Here, leadership means driving innovation and owning your impact; empathy shapes our people-first culture; growth is constant; quality defines everything we deliver; and curiosity fuels our drive to solve complex challenges.

Location
We strongly prefer individuals living in or near Sacramento, CA; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Portland, OR; Austin, TX; and St Louis, MO, but will make exceptions for the right candidates.

From treatment processes and pumping stations to remote monitoring and industrial automation, these systems are critical to maintaining resilient services for our customers and protecting the environment.

You'll play a key role in improving resilience, security and supportability across critical operational services used every day across the Anglian Water region.

  • Respond to system alerts, incidents and security events, ensuring risks are identified and addressed quickly

  • Support vulnerability remediation and cyber security activities in collaboration with security teams

  • Manage firmware updates, network patches and infrastructure lifecycle activities

  • Support projects delivering new Operational Technology solutions, providing technical input to designs, testing and implementation

  • Lead testing activities for Operational Technology network changes and upgrades

  • Maintain accurate asset records and ensure compliance with change management processes

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on network performance, security and resilience

What we're looking for

  • Experience maintaining and supporting complex TCP/IP network environments

  • Strong understanding of networking technologies, routing protocols, subnetting and IP address management

  • Experience troubleshooting network infrastructure issues in operational or business-critical environments

  • Strong understanding of cyber security principles and network security controls

  • Experience working within IT service management and change management processes

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and fault-finding skills

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Experience supporting projects and technical change activity

  • Full UK Driving Licence

  • The role requires CTC security clearance, or the ability to obtain it

Desirable:

  • Experience working within Operational Technology, industrial control, SCADA or telemetry environments.

  • Experience with Azure, AWS or other cloud environments. Knowledge of user acceptance testing and release management.

  • Relevant networking or infrastructure qualifications.

  • Experience working within utilities, manufacturing or other industrial sectors.

Why join Anglian Water?

At Anglian Water, we are driven by purpose - delivering resilient services while protecting the environment for future generations.

In this role, you will help maintain and secure critical infrastructure that underpins water and water recycling operations, work within a growing Operational Technology domain supporting Industry 4.0 and digital transformation initiatives, and gain exposure to cutting-edge networking, cyber security and operational technology solutions.

You will contribute to projects that directly improve performance, resilience, leakage reduction and environmental outcomes, while being part of a collaborative team that values innovation, learning and continuous improvement.

Dukas Linden Public Relations (DLPR), an Infinite Company, is a communications partner for leaders in finance, asset and wealth management, banking, capital markets, professional services, and digital assets. Founded in 2002, we help category-leading firms and innovators expand their share of voice and reach the audiences that matter most in a global marketplace.

Ranked among the top financial PR firms by O'Dwyer's, DLPR brings a deep bench of senior talent and a newsroom-first approach that consistently lands top-tier results. Our teams place clients across outlets like CNBC, Bloomberg, the Wall Street Journal, and Barron's, with sector strength spanning accounting, consulting, compliance, and law.


As part of Infinite, an international communications firm specializing in PR, Content & Campaigns, and Crisis & Litigation, DLPR now offers clients an even broader platform, pairing deep financial services expertise with an international network across the US and UK.

What we’re looking for

A skilled financial communications professional with proficient team and client management skills and a sophisticated understanding of the asset and wealth management markets. The Director supervises accounts and account teams, articulates and drives execution of media relations and thought leadership programs, and serves as a trusted counselor to clients and senior executives on strategic communications matters.

This role is well suited to someone currently at a leading financial PR firm, or in-house at an investment or wealth management firm, who is looking for the opportunity to work with premier clients, help shape strategy, and make a meaningful impact. In addition to managing junior colleagues, the Director is expected to lead by example and play a key role in expanding relationships with existing clients while contributing to new business.

What you’d do

  • Lead strategic communications and media relations programs for top asset managers, wealth managers, and other financial services clients.
  • Develop creative, proactive media strategies that generate consistent, high-impact coverage in top-tier business, financial, and trade media.
  • Build and execute thought leadership campaigns for CEOs, CIOs, portfolio managers, strategists, and other senior executives.
  • Serve as a highly responsive day-to-day client contact and lead client meetings and calls with the support of junior colleagues.
  • Demonstrate a sophisticated understanding of clients’ business and provide thoughtful counsel on communications strategy, messaging, reputation management, and media positioning.
  • Cultivate and leverage relationships with leading financial journalists, editors, producers, and podcast hosts.
  • Identify timely opportunities tied to market developments, economic news, and industry trends that position clients at the center of important conversations.
  • Demonstrate strong strategic, analytical, and project management skills; take responsibility for a diverse number of projects and complete them in a timely manner with general direction from the account lead.
  • Participate in the new business process by articulating strategies and tactics and displaying strong presentation skills during pitch meetings.
  • Cultivate business growth opportunities among existing clients by introducing new services and capabilities.
  • Manage operational performance of account teams. Ensure quality work, deadline adherence, effective processes, and that the team consistently meets or exceeds agreed upon expectations, deliverables, and metrics.
  • Serve as a manager for junior professionals; provide onboarding support, training, and ongoing feedback, and participate in reviews.
  • Act as a mentor for junior colleagues by modeling desired behavior; demonstrate a strong work ethic, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to collegiality and a growth mindset.
  • Commit to continuous learning and improvement of professional and leadership skills; set and pursue stretch goals.
  • Lead by example; demonstrate behaviors consistent with Infinite’s values (integrity, agility, compassion, and courage).

Why we want you

  • You have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • You have a minimum of seven years’ public relations or corporate communications experience, with at least four years in an account and people management role.
  • You have substantial experience representing asset managers, wealth managers, or other financial services organizations.
  • You have a proven track record securing high-profile coverage in top-tier business and financial media, including outlets such as CNBC, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, Financial Times, Reuters, Yahoo Finance, and leading industry publications.
  • You have exceptional media relationships with financial reporters, editors, producers, and influencers.
  • You are highly curious, creative, and self-motivated, with superior critical thinking, communication, and interpersonal skills, as well as a fluent understanding of how to motivate and problem solve.
  • You are a strong strategic thinker with the ability to translate complex investment topics into compelling stories.
  • You have a broad and thorough understanding of all facets of media relations and communications considerations for financial services organizations, with the ability to understand complex situations and anticipate client needs.
  • You have demonstrated the ability to lead multiple teams and projects simultaneously and under tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality deliverables, effective team communication, and strong client service.
  • You have proven experience counseling senior business leaders on communications matters.
  • You have demonstrated strength as a writer; knowledge of AP style and the ability to proof, edit, and coach others’ writing abilities.
  • You have a collaborative leadership style and a genuine desire to mentor junior professionals.
  • Most importantly, you love financial communications and thrive in a fast-moving, high-performance environment.

Who we work with

DLPR combines the entrepreneurial culture of a growing firm with the opportunity to represent some of the most innovative and influential organizations in financial services. Our clients include:

  • Leading retail and institutional asset managers
  • Wealth management firms and RIAs
  • Private equity and alternative investment firms
  • Investment and commercial banks
  • ETF issuers and investment strategists
  • Professional services firms serving the financial industry

We are a high-energy, collaborative team that believes great work comes from smart people who enjoy what they do. Our professionals are trusted advisors to some of the biggest names in financial services, and every day presents the opportunity to work on interesting, impactful assignments that shape industry conversations.


What we offer

  • The opportunity to work with some of the industry’s premier asset and wealth management firms.
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with significant opportunities for growth.
  • Friendly and highly collaborative working environment where your voice will be heard and your ideas will count.
  • A focus on growth and professional development: twice annual professional planning sessions, regular access to leadership and mentorship opportunities.
  • Hybrid work schedule; two days in the office with three optional work-from-home days per week.
  • Competitive compensation, bonus opportunities, and new business incentives.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • 401(k) with employer contribution.
  • Ample time off: 15 vacation days, 10 annual company holidays, nine days paid sick leave, one personal day and an “on call” period between Christmas and New Year’s.
  • Thorough onboarding and training process that extends throughout your tenure with the company.

Location: Montreal, Canada

Remote Type: Hybrid Work

Job Description

Overview:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:

The Computer Vision Software Developer I will work on Computer Vision projects turning Zebra’s core algorithms from prototypes to high quality product ready code. The developer will design and implement strategies for optimizing computer vision algorithms for different hardware architectures (e.g. x86, GPU, multi-core ARM CPU, AI accelerator) based on performance, power and size constraints. Work is evaluated upon completion to ensure objectives have been met.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Development of turning prototyped computer vision algorithms and deep learning algorithms into high quality product ready code
• Learns to design and provide strategies for optimizing computer vision algorithms for different embedded system and mobile devices
• Participate and provide input in project code reviews
• Receive detailed instructions to routine work, new projects or assignments
• Design and/or review architected modules and software systems supporting new technology or improving capability/performance of existing functionality
• Take responsibility for communicating with different engineers (embedded systems, backend server, computer vision) to continuously improve and optimize implemented algorithms
• Create automated software tests and provide support to trouble shoot software issues when needed
• Documentation of software architecture

Job Requirements
• Bachelor in Computer Engineering/Computer Science (preferably with specialization in computer vision and machine learning);
• Preferred work experience (years): 0-2 years
• Basic understanding of computer vision; key areas of interest include at least 1 of the following: object detection, tracking and recognition, multiple view geometry, OCR, anomaly detection, camera calibrations, 3D data processing, segmentation, image recognition
• Optimization experience on embedded GPU or AI accelerator platforms: Nvidia, ARM.
• Parallelized & vectorized computation.
• Optional: Solid GPU programming experience using CUDA or Open CL
• Good Modern C++, Python programming skills.

•Must speak French

Le/la développeur ou la développeuse de logiciels en vision par ordinateur I travaillera sur des projets de vision par ordinateur, transformant les algorithmes fondamentaux de Zebra de l'état de prototype à du code de haute qualité prêt pour la production. Cette personne concevra et mettra en œuvre des stratégies pour optimiser les algorithmes de vision par ordinateur pour diverses architectures matérielles (par exemple, x86, GPU, processeur ARM multi-cœur, accélérateur d'IA) en fonction des contraintes de performance, de consommation d'énergie et de taille. Le travail sera évalué à son achèvement pour garantir que les objectifs ont été atteints.

Tâches et responsabilités essentielles :

Transformer des algorithmes de vision par ordinateur et d'apprentissage profond au stade de prototype en code de haute qualité prêt pour la production.

Apprendre à concevoir et à proposer des stratégies pour l'optimisation d'algorithmes de vision par ordinateur pour différents systèmes embarqués et appareils mobiles.

Participer aux révisions de code des projets et y apporter sa contribution.

Recevoir des instructions détaillées pour le travail courant, les nouveaux projets ou les nouvelles affectations.

Concevoir et/ou réviser des modules et des systèmes logiciels qui soutiennent les nouvelles technologies ou qui améliorent la capacité et la performance des fonctionnalités existantes.

Assurer la communication avec les différents ingénieurs (systèmes embarqués, serveur dorsal, vision par ordinateur) afin d'améliorer et d'optimiser continuellement les algorithmes mis en œuvre.

Créer des tests logiciels automatisés et fournir un soutien pour la résolution des problèmes logiciels au besoin.

Documenter l'architecture logicielle.

Exigences du poste :

Baccalauréat en génie informatique ou en informatique (de préférence avec une spécialisation en vision par ordinateur et en apprentissage automatique).

Expérience de travail souhaitée : 0 à 2 ans.

Compréhension de base de la vision par ordinateur ; les domaines d'intérêt clés comprennent au moins l'un des suivants : détection, suivi et reconnaissance d'objets, géométrie multi-vues, ROC (reconnaissance optique de caractères), détection d'anomalies, étalonnage de caméras, traitement de données 3D, segmentation, reconnaissance d'images.

Expérience en optimisation sur des plateformes de GPU embarqués ou d'accélérateurs d'IA : Nvidia, ARM.

Calcul parallélisé et vectorisé.

Facultatif : Solide expérience en programmation GPU avec CUDA ou OpenCL.

Bonnes compétences en programmation C++ moderne et Python.

title: Data Modeller
description:
Why this role exists:

The Data Modeller provides the foundational structural design for Officeworks data assets, ensuring information is organised, accessible, and high-performing across enterprise platforms. By designing robust logical and physical models for Snowflake and Datasphere, this role enables the business to transition toward a self-serve analytics model and democratised data access. The role plays a critical part in the execution of the enterprise data strategy, bridging the gap between raw data ingestion and the delivery of curated, semantic layers that power advanced analytics and AI initiatives.

Where you will make a difference:

In this role you will:

Data Architecture & Modelling:

  • Design and maintain complex logical and physical data models for the Snowflake enterprise data platform and SAP Datasphere.
  • Define and develop curated and semantic layers to ensure data is structured for optimal business consumption.
  • Ensure all data models align with established canonical models and the enterprise business glossary to maintain consistency across the Technology function.

Performance & Optimisation:

  • Optimise data models and structures to ensure high performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency within cloud environments.
  • Support data lineage and metadata integration to ensure transparency, traceability, and trust in data assets.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers and Architects to ensure physical implementation aligns with architectural intent and performance requirements.

Process Improvement & Continuous Improvement:

  • Proactively identify opportunities to streamline data modelling workflows and improve the quality of the data lifecycle.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the Data & AI team to enhance operational efficiency and technical documentation standards.
  • Contribute to the evolution of data modelling standards and best practices at Officeworks, ensuring they remain fit-for-purpose as the AI and data landscape evolves.

Who you will be working with:

  • Data Team: Collaborate with Engineers, Architects, and the Data Platform Manager to deliver integrated data solutions.
  • Analytics Teams: Partner with Data Scientists and Analysts to ensure data structures support advanced analytical models.
  • Business Stakeholders: Interact with functional partners to understand reporting requirements and translate them into semantic data models.
  • Quality Teams: Engage with QA Associate Analysts to ensure data models meet rigorous enterprise standards and governance requirements.

What success looks like:

  • Model Integrity: Data models are accurately aligned with the enterprise canonical model and business glossary.
  • Platform Performance: Snowflake and Datasphere environments operate efficiently with optimised query performance and structured semantic layers.
  • Operational Excellence: Consistent delivery of high-quality documentation and improved data modelling processes within the Data & Analytics hub.
  • Self-Serve Enablement: Successful delivery of data assets that enable business users to perform self-serve analytics with minimal intervention.

How you will lead:

Individual Contributor:

  • Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
  • Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
  • Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
  • Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop

Qualifications and work experience:

Essential:

  • Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3-5+ years in Data Modelling or Data Engineering roles, with a focus on designing enterprise-scale data warehouses.
  • Technical Expertise: Proven experience in logical and physical data modelling, specifically for Snowflake and SAP data environments.
  • Platform Knowledge: Hands-on experience with Snowflake, GitHub, and modern data warehouse architectures (Medallion/Layered architecture).
  • Adaptability: Demonstrated ability to adapt technical skills from traditional Machine Learning environments to emerging AI-driven data requirements.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical data structures.

Preferred:

  • Industry Experience: Experience within a large-scale Retail or complex commercial environment is highly regarded.
  • Advanced Systems: Familiarity with SAP BW migration projects or SAP Datasphere.
  • Tooling: Experience with enterprise data modelling tools and metadata management platforms.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in software development.
  • Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments
  • Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP)
  • Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus

What we offer

title: Senior Engineer - Data
description:
Why this role exists:

The Senior Engineer (Data) is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines to support Officeworks enterprise data strategy and the evolution of AI-driven capabilities. By leveraging the Snowflake enterprise data platform and modern ELT frameworks, the role ensures that high-quality data from core systems like SAP, Salesforce, and Adobe is accessible for advanced analytics and self-serve reporting.

As a senior member of the Technology team, this role plays a critical part in driving data democratisation and continuous improvement, providing the technical foundations that enable Officeworks to make data-led decisions and improve customer outcomes.

Where you will make a difference:

In this role you will:

Data Pipeline Engineering & Scalability

  • Design and build scalable, automated data pipelines using Snowflake, AWS/GCP, and modern ELT frameworks.
  • Lead the ingestion of diverse datasets from key enterprise systems including SAP, Salesforce, and Adobe into the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP).
  • Implement complex transformation logic using dbt and SQL pipelines to ensure data is business ready.

Platform Optimisation & Governance

  • Monitor and optimise data pipeline performance and cloud compute cost efficiency within the Snowflake environment.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and metadata to ensure data lineage and transparency.
  • Support the transition toward a self-serve analytics model by ensuring data architectures support democratised access.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of high-quality code and engineering excellence.
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure all data engineering work aligns with established architectural standards and security protocols.

Continuous Improvement & Process Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual data processes and improve the reliability of the data ecosystem.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives in data engineering workflows to reduce technical debt and increase delivery velocity.
  • Champion best practices in CI/CD and DevOps for data engineering within the Data & AI hub.

Who you will be working with:

  • Technology Teams: Collaborate with the Data Architect, Data Modellers, and the AI team to align engineering efforts with broader architectural and AI roadmaps.
  • Analytics Team: Partner with Data Scientists and Analysts to understand data requirements and ensure the delivery of high-quality datasets.
  • Delivery Hub: Contribute to a high-performance and collaborative engineering culture.
  • Stakeholders: Engage with broader Technology leaders to support the execution of the enterprise data strategy and the migration from legacy systems.

What success looks like:

  • Reliable Data Assets: Successful deployment and maintenance of stable, scalable data pipelines with minimal downtime and high data integrity.
  • Technical Excellence: Delivery of high-quality, well-documented code that adheres to Officeworks engineering standards and promotes reusability.
  • Operational Efficiency: Measurable improvements in pipeline performance and cost-optimisation within the cloud data environment.
  • Continuous Growth: Demonstrable contribution to the capability uplift of the engineering team through effective mentorship and the implementation of process improvements.

How you will lead:

Individual Contributor

  • Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
  • Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
  • Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
  • Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop

Qualifications and work experience:

Essential

  • Education: Tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5-7 years in Data Engineering or related roles, with extensive experience building production-grade ELT/ETL pipelines.
  • Technical Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in SQL and deep hands-on experience with Snowflake and dbt (data build tool).
  • Cloud Proficiency: Demonstrated experience working within AWS or GCP ecosystems to manage large-scale data ingestion and storage.
  • Adaptability: Proven ability to adapt to new technologies (including shifting from traditional ML to AI frameworks) and a strong cultural fit for a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Industry Context: Experience within a large-scale Retail or Omnichannel environment, particularly involving SAP or Salesforce integrations.
  • Advanced Tooling: Familiarity with GitHub for version control and automated CI/CD deployment workflows.

title: Enablement Lead for Container Hosting Platforms
description:
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche!

Advances in artificial intelligence (AI), data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximizing these opportunities.

The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CSCoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and AI to assist our scientists in pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative medicines for patients worldwide. Within the CSCoE, the Data and Digital Catalysts (DDC) organization drives the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science, and accelerate decision making.

The Role

The Enablement Lead for Container Hosting Platforms sits within our Engineering core, serving as a high-impact bridge to our scientific user community. This role is accountable for driving the effective adoption, usability, and scientific impact of our core hosting platforms.

You will focus on reducing friction, accelerating onboarding, and radically improving the developer experience (DevEx) for researchers, primarily supporting CSCoE and gRED use cases in the United States. The role spans a complex technical landscape, covering multi-region (US/EU) general-purpose EKS hosting, specialized GPU and scale-out compute infrastructure, and the full breadth of AWS managed services required for modern application hosting. This includes storage, databases, event processing, workflow management, and serverless computing. You will ensure these environments are intuitive, accessible, and optimized for the unique demands of modern drug discovery.

The Opportunity:

  • Define, communicate, and continuously improve strategies for onboarding, adoption, and effective use of diverse scientific computing platforms.

  • Develop and lead comprehensive strategies for the adoption of cloud-native computing platforms, ensuring technical capabilities translate into cross-domain scientific outcomes.

  • Assist in the resolution of highly technical challenges related to containerized workloads, GPU-accelerated computing, and scale-out infrastructures.

  • Proactively identify and dismantle organizational and technical barriers to platform adoption, implementing solutions to reduce developer friction and enhance usability and accessibility.

  • Build and nurture communities of practice to share knowledge, best practices, and innovations.

  • Develop and deliver training and maintain high-quality documentation, tutorials, and example workflows.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to users and senior stakeholders, providing guidance on platform capabilities and best practices.

  • Influence product roadmaps where appropriate based on deep analysis of scientific usage patterns and direct researcher and developer feedback.

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, life sciences, or information technology with 5-8+ years of relevant experience.

  • Extensive experience designing, operating, and enabling Amazon Web Services (AWS) Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) environments.

  • Experience supporting research computing environments, including bioinformatics, cheminformatics, and AI/ML.

  • Experience in software engineering with proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python or Go.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar.

  • A relentless focus on usability and the continuous improvement of the researcher experience.

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and influence technical direction across cross-functional teams.

Onsite presence, on our South San Francisco campus, is expected for at least 3 days a week.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions.

As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will contribute to Inflammation discovery programs by planning and coordinating project tasks, generating and interpreting high-quality experimental data, and applying computational and AI-enabled approaches to deepen our understanding of disease biology, refine therapeutic hypotheses and support target discovery.

You will work on developing high-performance replication pipelines, efficient data synchronization mechanisms, and secure data transfer systems. This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems and strong technical leadership to deliver a scalable and resilient replication foundation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop multi-threaded asynchronous replication systems with parallel streaming capabilities

  • Build object-level delta replication with checkpointing and resume functionality

  • Develop replication engines supporting bucket/share-level replication controls

  • Implement secure data transfer mechanisms using TLS 1.3 with mutual authentication

  • Ensure end-to-end data integrity through checksum validation and verification pipelines

  • Design and implement manual failover workflows for disaster recovery scenarios

  • Build and maintain REST APIs for replication configuration, control, and automation

  • Develop metadata tracking and change detection systems to enable efficient replication

  • Implement RPO visibility, alerting, and operational insights for replication status

  • Contribute to monitoring dashboards focused on replication health and performance

  • Ensure systems are designed for high availability, fault tolerance, and scalability

  • Partner with QA teams to drive performance, resiliency, and scale validation

  • Collaborate with backend, security, and platform teams to deliver end-to-end replication workflows

  • Participate in debugging, production issue resolution, and continuous improvement of replication reliability

  • Provide technical leadership, architectural guidance, and mentorship to the engineering team

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in distributed systems, storage systems, or backend software engineering

  • Strong programming skills in one or more languages: C++, Go, Java, or Rust

  • Experience designing and building data replication systems, data pipelines, or distributed data services

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts (consistency, availability, scalability, fault tolerance)

  • Strong expertise in multi-threading, concurrency, and parallel processing

  • Knowledge of networking protocols and secure communication (TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS)

  • Experience implementing data integrity mechanisms (checksums, validation, consistency checks)

  • Experience designing and building REST APIs and service-based architectures

  • Familiarity with checkpointing, failure recovery, and retry mechanisms in distributed systems

  • Basic understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logging, alerting)

  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and system design skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with asynchronous replication, disaster recovery (DR), or backup systems

  • Familiarity with object storage or large-scale data storage systems

  • Knowledge of delta encoding, change data capture, or incremental data synchronization techniques

  • Experience building high-throughput, low-latency data movement systems

  • Exposure to security practices including mutual TLS, encryption, and authentication

  • Experience working on enterprise-scale data platforms or storage products

  • Familiarity with performance optimization and large-scale system tuning

description:

The Data Scientist will lead the development of data-driven solutions by leveraging traditional data science techniques and recent advancements in Generative AI to bring value to ADM. The role is integral to the Digital & Innovation team, driving rapid prototyping efforts, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and developing innovative approaches to solve business problems. This position requires a blend of expertise in traditional machine learning models, data science practices, and emerging AI technologies to create value and improve business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end machine learning projects, from data exploration, modeling, and deployment, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Utilize traditional AI/data science methods (e.g., regression, classification, clustering) and advanced AI methods (e.g., neural networks, NLP) to address business problems and optimize processes.

Educational Requirements:

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist (IN), Senior

Location: Pune, India

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Overview:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:

Design, optimize, and maintain scalable ETL pipelines using PySpark, and Databricks on cloud platforms (Azure/GCP).

Develop automated data validation process to proactively perform data quality checks.

Employ key Databricks modules (DeltaLake, Unity Catalog, MLFlow) to facilitate creating and scheduling jobs on Databricks.

Optimize the allocation of cloud resources to manage and control cloud cost.

Employ GitHub code management repositories and ensure that best practices are being implemented.

Build and tune ML/AI and optimization models, identify improvement opportunities, and perform experiments to demonstrate incremental value.

Have frequent conversations with Business Stakeholders to understand their requirements and concerns. Explain data deficiencies, model performance/root cause analysis, and model explainability.

Follow best practices in Data Architecture, Coding, and Project Management operations.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as Customers’ Stakeholders, Engagement Managers, Data Ops/Job Monitoring, Product Management & Software Engineering.

Expand the use of analytics, ML/AI, mathematical optimization, Gen-AI/LLMs and Agentic-AI in the context of Retail/CPG business use cases such as anomaly detection, demand forecasting, price elasticity modeling, promotions features & strategy simulation, product cannibalization and halo modeling, markdown optimization, product allocation, reorder/replenishment, size and pack optimization, workforce scheduling & task optimization.

Responsibilities

Minimum education:

Master’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, operations research, statistics, mathematics, quantitative sciences, or relevant work experience.

Minimum work experience:

3+ years of experience in Data Science or Data Engineering with emphasis on the full lifecycle of demand forecasting or time-series modeling projects — including production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing model performance management.

Within that timeframe, experience is expected in: Python/PySpark, SQL, and relational or NoSQL databases, and cloud resource management.

Key skills and competencies

  • Hands-on experience designing and operating production demand forecasting systems using statistical time-series methods (ARIMA, exponential smoothing) and regression-based approaches (log-linear regression, LASSO) for price elasticity and promotional lift modeling. Familiarity with hierarchical and weekly SKU-level forecasting at retail scale.

  • Direct experience in retail or CPG demand forecasting, promotional planning, or supply-chain analytics — either as a vendor delivering forecasting platforms to retailers, or in-house on a retail/CPG demand planning team. Comfort interacting with merchant, replenishment, or supply-chain stakeholders to explain forecasting decisions.

  • Track record across the full lifecycle of forecasting platforms — designing and building new components for incoming customers, evolving existing pipelines as customer needs change, diagnosing production issues, and explaining model behavior to customer planners and merchants.

  • Proven experience building end-to-end production-grade data and ML pipelines using PySpark, Python (Pandas/NumPy), and/or SQL — including ingestion of customer transactional and master data, feature engineering for promotional and seasonal effects, model training and scoring at scale, and producing forecasts consumed by downstream merchandising and replenishment systems.

  • Experience with forecast accuracy measurement (MAPE, WAPE, bias decomposition) and using accuracy diagnostics to drive iterative model improvements in production.

  • Experience working with AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud environments at production scale.

  • Experience with orchestration tools like Databricks, Airflow (or similar tools like Snowflake, Dagster, etc.).

  • Experience working with Git (or similar code management repositories) as a collaboration tool.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially as it relates to technical communications. Ability to present technical analysis — including model behavior, forecast deviations, and recommended actions — to business stakeholders and customer planners.

  • Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and achieve stretch goals in a very innovative and fast-paced environment.

Benefits:

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

Job Posting Statement:

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

AI Technology Statement:

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

description:

The IT Quality Assurance Advisor is responsible for leading testing strategy, test automation, and quality assurance activities for Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) applications and integrated enterprise systems. This role serves as a subject matter expert (SME) for Oracle EBS Order Management, Supply Chain, Repairs, and Finance business processes while driving the adoption of modern testing practices, automation frameworks, and quality engineering methodologies.
The advisor partners with business stakeholders, product owners, functional analysts, developers, and project teams to ensure enterprise solutions meet business requirements, maintain system integrity, and deliver exceptional quality. This position provides leadership in test planning, automation strategy, defect management, release validation, and continuous quality improvement initiatives across multiple projects and programs.

Job Description

  • Lead quality assurance activities for Oracle EBS enhancements, integrations, upgrades, support initiatives, and strategic business projects.

Required Test Automation Skills

  • Experience testing integrations involving:Oracle EBS REST APIs Middleware platforms Data warehouses Reporting systems
  • Experience validating complex workflows involving finance, order fulfillment, inventory management, procurement, and repair operations.
  • Experience with defect lifecycle management and root cause analysis.

Preferred Qualifications

Since 1938, BHN has helped individuals, families, and communities thrive through compassionate, high-quality care and support. With deep roots in Western Massachusetts and a growing presence in communities throughout the state, we are currently seeking a FFS Clinician Licensed to join our Community Behavioral Health Center (CBHC) Outpatient Services team and help advance our mission of empowering people to live healthier, more fulfilling lives.

What We Offer:

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Make a meaningful impact in the lives of individuals, families, and communities throughout Western Massachusetts.
  • Professional Growth – Access ongoing training, mentorship, career development, and advancement opportunities across one of the region's largest behavioral health organizations.
  • Supportive Team Culture – Join a collaborative workplace guided by our HEART values: Humanity, Empowerment, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork.
  • Stability & Opportunity – Build your career with a well-established organization serving Western Massachusetts since 1938.
  • Comprehensive Benefits – Generous PTO, 403(b), educational assistance, medical, dental, vision, employee assistance programs, and more.
  • Certified Great Place to Work – Work for an organization recognized for creating a positive and engaging employee experience.

What You Will Do:

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to complete comprehensive behavioral health assessments and determine the appropriate level of care using evidence-based clinical tools and sound clinical judgment.
  • Provide short-term, solution-focused interventions through the CBHC Access Center and deliver individual, couples, family, and group therapy using BHN-approved evidence-based frameworks and treatment pathways.
  • Complete comprehensive risk and safety evaluations and take appropriate action to support the safety of individuals served and others.
  • Coordinate regularly with Access Navigators, care team members, family members, guardians, residential providers, and other community partners to support integrated, person-centered treatment.
  • Help individuals make measurable progress toward assessed needs and treatment goals, using standardized assessment and outcome tools to guide care.
  • Support individuals in transitioning to the least intensive clinically appropriate level of care while maintaining treatment frequency and duration consistent with medical necessity and utilization-management guidelines.
  • Complete progress notes, comprehensive and diagnostic assessments, Integrated Individual Action Plans, plan updates, and other required clinical documentation accurately and within established timelines.
  • Maintain an appropriate caseload, direct-service volume, work schedule, and performance expectations, adjusting scheduling and caseload mix as needed to meet program objectives.

  • Protect confidentiality and comply with HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, ethical standards, payer requirements, regulatory requirements, and BHN policies.
  • Participate in clinical supervision, team meetings, evidence-based treatment consultation, required training, and continuing education while working toward or maintaining professional licensure.

Who You Are:

  • Master's degree in a license-eligible behavioral health field required.
  • Must hold or be actively working toward an eligible behavioral health license in accordance with payer, funder, and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience or training working with individuals who have co-occurring mental health and substance-use disorders, or a demonstrated willingness to develop this expertise.

title: Engineer - Data
description:
Why this role exists:

The Engineer (Data) develops and maintains the robust data pipelines and transformations required to power Officeworks enterprise data platform and emerging AI capabilities. The role supports the Technology function by integrating diverse data sources into Snowflake, ensuring high data quality and system reliability to enable a self-serve analytics model. It plays an important part in the execution of the enterprise data strategy, helping Officeworks to democratise data access and drive informed decision-making across the business.

Where you will make a difference:

In this role you will:

Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

  • Develop, maintain, and optimise scalable data pipelines to support business-critical reporting and analytics.
  • Integrate complex data sets from various sources, including SAP Datasphere, Salesforce, and Adobe, into Snowflake.
  • Support the implementation of data modelling and transformation logic to ensure data is fit for purpose.

Operational Monitoring & Reliability

  • Monitor pipeline health and proactively address failures to maintain data integrity and availability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues, ensuring minimal disruption to downstream consumers.
  • Contribute to the improvement of data monitoring frameworks and alerting systems.

Process & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive process improvement initiatives within the data engineering lifecycle to enhance delivery speed and quality.
  • Identify opportunities for automation within manual data workflows and transformation steps.
  • Regularly review and refine existing pipelines to ensure they align with evolving performance standards and best practices.

Engineering Excellence & CI/CD

  • Contribute to and maintain CI/CD workflows to ensure seamless and reliable code deployment.
  • Adhere to engineering standards for documentation, version control (GitHub), and code quality.
  • Collaborate with Quality Analysts to ensure data work meets rigorous testing and validation standards.

Who you will be working with:

  • Data & AI Team: Partner with the Data Platform Manager, Technical Associate Managers, and peer Engineers to deliver integrated data solutions.
  • Analytics Teams: Collaborate with Data Scientists and Analysts to provide the foundational data structures required for machine learning and AI initiatives.
  • Architectural Leads: Work with the Data Architect to ensure pipelines align with the enterprise data strategy and Snowflake platform standards.
  • Functional Business Partners: Engage with stakeholders across Salesforce, Adobe, and SAP workstreams to understand source system complexities.

What success looks like:

  • Pipeline Reliability: Data pipelines are highly available, with minimal downtime and rapid resolution of identified failures.
  • Data Democratisation: Successful integration of key data sources into Snowflake, enabling self-serve capabilities for business users.
  • Continuous Improvement: Demonstrable improvements in pipeline performance, automation levels, and engineering process efficiency.
  • Delivery Quality: Consistent delivery of data transformations that meet technical specifications and business requirements within agreed timeframes.

How you will lead:

Individual Contributor

  • Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
  • Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
  • Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
  • Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop

Qualifications and work experience:

Essential

  • Education: A Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of experience in data engineering or data development roles within a complex corporate environment.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in GitHub for version control and experience developing within the Snowflake data platform.
  • Data Integration: Proven experience integrating data from large-scale enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
  • Transformation Knowledge: Strong understanding of data modelling, SQL, and transformation logic.
  • Adaptability: Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving data environments, specifically shifting from traditional ML to AI-ready data structures.

Preferred

  • Retail Context: Experience working within the retail or omnichannel sector.
  • System Exposure: Familiarity with SAP Datasphere, Adobe data structures, or Machine Learning (ML) system architectures.

title: Manufacturing Estimator
description:
Manufacturing Estimator

Landscape Architectural Site Furnishings & Engineered Rooftop Planting Systems


About Us


We are a design-driven manufacturer of landscape architectural site furnishings and engineered modular planting systems for commercial developments, rooftop terraces, amenity decks, and mixed-use environments. We offer custom design development and manufacturing of landscape architectural products including pergolas, outdoor kitchens, modular planting systems and public art.

Our work goes beyond standard planters and site elements. We engineer fully integrated systems that combine:


  • Custom planters
  • Fire and water features
  • Integrated seating
  • Lighting and audio integration
  • Guardrails
  • Structural attachment systems
  • Wind uplift performance
  • Saturated soil containment and drainage performance


Our systems are often written into project specifications and require coordination across structural, architectural, waterproofing, and landscape disciplines.


Position Overview


We are seeking a detail-oriented Estimator with a strong background in custom metal fabrication and architectural assemblies. This role is responsible for the technical lifecycle of the bidding process—from interpreting complex architectural drawings to preparing final "hard bids" for engineered systems.


You will work directly with:

  • Architects and Landscape Architects (specification phase).
  • ORE internal Teams: Sales, Design Development, CAD, Project Management and Production Scheduling.
  • General Contractors and Specialty Subcontractors (bidding and construction).


Key Responsibilities


  • Bid Preparation: Lead the preparation of comprehensive "hard bids" for custom architectural projects, including pergolas, modular planting systems, and integrated site furnishings.
  • Technical Take-offs: Perform precise quantity take-offs and budgetary cost analysis for fully integrated systems that combine planters, seating, lighting, and audio.
  • Proposal Development: Develop clear and concise item descriptions and qualifications for proposals, ensuring accuracy and technical understanding for both internal teams and clients.
  • Performance Evaluation: Analyze architectural and structural plans to estimate requirements for specialized criteria such as wind uplift performance, structural attachment systems, and drainage performance.
  • Material & Production Strategy: Evaluate technical material requirements (specifically aluminum and custom metals) and coordinate with the Supply Chain team to ensure accurate pricing and availability.
  • Shop & Design Coordination: Partner with internal Design Development and production teams to estimate labor and fabrication timelines for complex, site-specific solutions.
  • Strategic Follow-up: Execute diligent bid follow-up and maintain professional relationships with General Contractors and bidding subcontractors through the project award phase.
  • Process Innovation: Actively seek opportunities to innovate and improve the estimating workflow; explore and integrate emerging technologies to streamline the transition from design development to final bid.


Required Experience


  • Industry Experience: 5+ years of experience in technical estimating, specifically within architectural metals, landscape architectural products, building envelope systems, or structural systems.
  • Education: BA/BS degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field is preferred; or an equivalent combination of professional experience and technical training.
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of architectural systems, including fabrication workflows, finishing processes, and relevant codes (IBC and wind load requirements).
  • Software Skills: Proficiency in Bluebeam Revu, Excel-based estimating systems, and ERP systems (NetSuite preferred); familiarity with SolidWorks or similar 3D modeling software is a plus.
  • Detail Orientation: Ability to navigate complex site-specific challenges—such as saturated soil containment and structural load-bearing requirements—with a high degree of accuracy.


Why Join Us


  • Work on high-profile, landmark architectural projects that define modern commercial and rooftop environments.
  • Be part of a design-forward, engineering-driven manufacturing company where technical expertise is at the core.
  • Directly influence project profitability and manufacturing efficiency through technical precision and collaborative design-to-bid strategies.
  • Opportunity to lead process innovation and leverage emerging technologies to shape the future of our estimating workflow.


Employee Benefits


  • 10 paid holidays yearly
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Competitive pay with regular pay increases
  • Tuition and certification reimbursement
  • Exceptional facility that is clean, safe, organized and well lit
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Life & Disability Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
  • Dependent Care Reimbursement Account (DCRA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) including free counseling for employees
  • Retirement saving plan with 401K company match program
  • Your safety is our priority - safe and clean workplace that goes above required guidelines
  • Regular staff meetings to increase communication
  • Summer and Holiday Parties
  • Employee recognition
  • Monthly social events



Schedule & Pay


  • Full-time position: Mondays through Fridays, 8:00 am – 4:30 pm.
  • Hours: Schedule may vary slightly depending on business needs and project demands.
  • Location: Onsite at our location in Woods Cross, Utah.
  • Salary: We offer a competitive base salary that is comparable to industry standards.


Physical Requirements


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential responsibilities of this job. title: Digital Innovation & EMR Team Lead
description:
The Hospital:

The Royal Children’s Hospital’s (RCH) Vision is “A world where all kids thrive”.

RCH is a cornerstone member of the Melbourne Children’s Campus, partnering with Murdoch Children’s Research Institute, The University of Melbourne Department of Paediatrics and The Royal Children’s Hospital Foundation.

RCH has cared for the children and young people of Victoria for more than 150 years since it was founded in 1870. A full range of paediatrics and adolescent health services are provided plus tertiary and quaternary care for the most critically ill and medically complex patients in Victoria, Tasmania, southern NSW and other states around Australia and overseas. The Hospital has more than 6,000 staff, a budget of $850M, 12 wards and 350 beds. Annually, the RCH has 300,000+ Specialist Clinic appointments, 90,000+ Emergency Department presentations and 20,000 elective surgeries.

The RCH is committed to the Child Safe Standards.

RCH enjoys high employee engagement and is committed to staff safety and a positive culture through enactment of our Compact.

For further Information on RCH is available here.

About the Role:

This is a full-time (80hrs/fortnight incl. ADOs) ongoing opportunity within the Digital Innovation & EMR Team. The role is available to commence immediately.

The Digital Innovation & EMR Team Lead will be responsible to lead improvements to all clinically facing digital platforms at RCH. In particular, this spans the premier clinical application in use across the organisation, the electronic medical record (Epic Systems). Alongside this, the position is responsible for leading the contribution to the delivery of clinically facing digital applications and projects, including artificial intelligence solutions and health data/analytics initiatives.

The position will work with clinical stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement and then work to design and implement solutions. The work of the team is driven by strategic organisational priorities and the overarching RCH digital health strategy. This senior position reports to the Chief Clinical Innovation Officer and will collaborate with them on strategic design, work priorities as well as resolution and escalation of issues.

Classification for this role is as per the Health and Allied Services, Managers and Administrative Workers (Victorian Public Sector) (Single Interest Employers) Enterprise Agreement 2025 – 2027 (Award 10).

Depending on experience, this will be graded from AO81 (Grade 8, Year 1) to AO85 (Grade 8, Year 5), $124,912.84 to $137,858.24 per annum, plus superannuation.

What you’ll achieve:

  • Manage and oversee analysis of workflows, enhancement requests and other technical issues associated with the EMR and develop functional and technical solutions that reflect an in-depth understanding of the user’s requirements and software configurability
  • Explore creative digital solutions that meet the needs various clinical divisions, departments and craft groups
  • Oversee configuration, building, testing and system maintenance tasks to ensure the EMR application is available, current and well maintained
  • Develop business cases and project plans, provide work estimates, benefits and project scoping for digital innovation and EMR initiatives
  • Oversee and manage the delivery of the approved RCH EMR enhancements to ensure that end users are effectively engaged in the continuous improvement of the EMR to continue to support and improve the delivery of care provided
  • Contribute to the RCH digital strategy and provide inputs into how DI & EMR can contribute to broader organisational digital strategy
  • Be responsible and accountable for key deliverables of the DI & EMR analyst team
  • Mentor and motivate other DI & EMR analysts and manage team member performance
  • Allocation and accountability of build resources
  • Work closely with CCIO to ensure understanding of executive and division priorities, optimisations and service requests that support workflows
  • Provide fit for purpose solutions to problems identified and communicate options with stakeholders and agree a way forward

Your skills and experience:

  • Tertiary qualification in a related field (e.g. health, health informatics, information technology or equivalent) and/or relevant industry experience in a digital health or ICT role
  • Experience in the configuration, build and support of enterprise electronic medical record systems and/or digital health platforms or information systems
  • Proven leadership experience in a team environment and ability to work well as a senior team member
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver effective working relationships with colleagues across clinical areas and the wider business
  • Substantial experience working in or alongside healthcare services, with an understanding of clinical workflows and patient-centred care principles
  • Substantial experience and understanding of clinical workflows with demonstrated ability to engage and build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Epic certification and or equivalent experience – minimum of 4 years

If this sounds like you, or if you require further information, please click here to view the position description.

About the Department:

The DI & EMR team sits in the Digital Portfolio within the Digital and Allied Health Division. The Digital and Allied Health Division leads the hospital's digital transformation agenda, and is responsible for the implementation, optimisation and governance of digital health technologies, including the Electronic Medical Record, the RCH Patient Portal, artificial intelligence clinical solutions and virtual care platforms.

RCH has made significant investments in digital health capability, including the implementation and ongoing optimisation of the Epic Electronic Medical Record (EMR) shared across the Parkville precinct, expansion of virtual and digitally enabled models of care, maturation of enterprise data and analytics platforms, and the emerging adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in clinical and operational settings.

description:

We are looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer who will help design and build our Cluster management platform. DDN – Infinia engineers come from diverse backgrounds, and we consider them to be in the highest tier of technology game changers globally. They have created, architected and pioneered numerous advancements in data enabling technologies, and delivered groundbreaking ideas which have shaped and transformed the storage industry.

  • Production-Scale Observability Expertise: Hands-on experience implementing and operating telemetry pipelines for software-defined clustered, distributed, or cloud-native solutions.

  • Telemetry Industry Standards: Practical experience with the OpenTelemetry (OTel) ecosystem, including custom OTel collector configurations, instrumentation SDKs, and data processing.

  • Systems-Level Troubleshooting: A solid understanding of Linux networking, filesystems, and how clustered storage applications behave under heavy I/O workloads.

  • Collaborative Mindset: Proven ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams, driving technical clarity through code reviews and clear documentation.

What you have achieved…

  • Built and Maintained Telemetry Pipelines: A proven track record of developing or extending proprietary Go components to efficiently ingest, process, and forward massive streams of metrics, logs, and traces.

  • Optimized Resource Consumption: Experience managing the CPU and memory footprint of monitoring agents to ensure they do not compete with core storage data paths.

  • Strong Testing & Regression Habits: Dedication to writing robust unit and integration tests to ensure telemetry components remain stable during live cluster upgrades.

  • Independent Feature Delivery: A proven ability to take ownership of complex technical initiatives and independently make progress in a fast-paced environment.

  • Concept Visualization: Ability to turn abstract cluster state data into logical, well-structured telemetry frameworks that bring visibility to complex system scenarios.

What will you be doing

  • Execute the Telemetry Architecture: Take on core projects within the observability domain, ensuring seamless integration between our proprietary Go infrastructure and open-source tools.

  • Optimize the Observability Stack: Help design and refine how OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and VictoriaMetrics handle the massive metrics volume generated by our storage cluster.

  • Drive Code Excellence: Act as a key technical contributor to our Software Defined Storage control plane, writing clean, performant Go code and providing rigorous code reviews.

  • Full Lifecycle Engineering: Participate actively within the Scrum model—from initial design and coding to automated testing, usability reviews, and release.

  • Document and Standardize: Ensure our telemetry frameworks are well-documented, making it easy for other engineering teams to instrument their components properly.

  • Global Support Rotation: Contribute to our global team on-call rotation, leveraging your own observability tools to provide high-level technical support for our distributed footprint.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Forward Deployed
description:
About Us

Chakra Labs' mission is to encode human taste into intelligence. We build high-fidelity environments, evals, and datasets for frontier AI research, working with several of the top labs.

Our work sits at the frontier of post-training, agent environments, data quality, and research infrastructure. We care about building systems that make models better in ways that are measurable, useful, and hard to fake.

What You'd Work On

  • The hardest problems at the frontier. A new environment modality, an eval targeting a failure mode nobody's measured, a dataset that doesn't exist yet. You take problems like these from a researcher's hunch to a shipped deliverable, working at the edge of what agents can currently do.

  • Environments, evals, and datasets. One project is a high-fidelity environment, the next is a task distribution with grading logic, the next is a dataset built to a demanding spec. The bar is frontier-lab quality and the pace is relentless - you're writing whatever the deliverable needs: environment code, task specs, scoring harnesses.

  • Pulling the frontier into the platform. The best one-offs don't stay one-offs. You'd recognize when a custom build proves out a capability worth generalizing, and help fold it into the core product - so it compounds instead of sitting on a shelf.

About You

  • Full-stack range. You're a strong generalist engineer - comfortable across backend services, data pipelines, and enough frontend to ship a usable interface. TypeScript/Python or similar. You'd rather own a whole deliverable than a layer of one.

  • Fast in ambiguity. Requirements arrive as a hunch, not a spec. You can turn a loosely-defined research question into a concrete environment, task set, eval, or dataset - and validate that it measures what was meant, not just what was easy to build.

  • Customer instincts. You communicate clearly with researchers and technical customers, push back when they're asking for the wrong thing, and know the difference between what someone requests and what they need. The work moves between deep async stretches and high-bandwidth sessions with customers, in person when it counts.

  • Evals curiosity. You don't need an ML research background, but you're genuinely interested in how agents fail and how to measure it. You'll learn task design, LLM-judged scoring, and reward hacking detection on the job.

  • Experience. No hard rule. Ideally at least 3 years shipping production software, but less works if the above sounds like you.

What Makes This Different

  • You see the frontier first. The problems that land on your desk are the ones frontier researchers haven't solved yet. What you build is often the first working version of something the field will need - and you're the one who proves it's possible.

  • Real customers, real deadlines. Every project has a named customer and a researcher waiting on the output. This isn't building a platform and hoping someone uses it.

  • Ownership, not theater. You own whole deliverables and customer relationships, not tickets in a queue. One week you're shipping a custom eval for a lab, the next you're generalizing it into the core product.

  • The team. Our team is ex-Stripe, Snap, AWS, Microsoft, Airtable - you'll work with a small team who has years of shipping high-impact products over the last decade.

  • Cutting edge. You will get to touch the latest and greatest technologies across the data, AI, and infrastructure stack.
