title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Agentic AI
description:
Senior ML Engineer, Agentic AI

Department: Engineering

Location: San Francisco - Hybrid

Compensation: $175K – $250K

Employment Type: FullTime

Ellipsis Health is creating cutting-edge AI/ML products that solve healthcare staffing challenges and administrative burdens using conversational AI and our patented voice biomarker technology—helping deliver better healthcare for everyone. We are headquartered in Silicon Valley and are funded and supported by some of the most preeminent venture capital teams.

In this role, you will be a core contributor and technical leader within our AI Research & Engineering team. Operating at the sweet spot between cutting-edge scientific research and production-grade systems, you will drive the conceptualization, architecture, and deployment of frontier agentic systems. You will collaborate directly with core infrastructure and platform teams to translate algorithmic breakthroughs in LLMs and agentic AI into robust, secure, and low-latency clinical applications.

Responsibilities:

  • Technical Leadership & Vision: Act as the technical authority for the Agentic AI roadmap, steering engineering pods from initial research prototyping through to production scale.

  • Advanced Agentic Architecture: Design, build, and optimize scalable systems and orchestration pipelines capable of deep multi-step reasoning, dynamic memory allocation, long-context evaluation, and high-fidelity tool utilization.

  • Research-to-Production Translation: Bridge the gap between frontier machine learning research and enterprise software design. Implement and adapt state-of-the-art techniques in post-training fine-tuning, preference alignment, and automated prompt optimization.

  • Rigorous Evaluation & Benchmarking: Architect and maintain multi-dimensional quantitative evaluation frameworks and continuous testing infrastructure. Implement state-of-the-art LLM-as-a-judge rubrics, and statistical tracking to evaluate agent capabilities and guarantee zero-regression product updates.

  • Data Mix Optimization: Develop and scale automated data curation pipelines to extract, filter, and structure user feedback signals, execution logs, and expert labels into ultra-high-quality training datasets for model fine-tuning.

  • Cross-Functional & Clinical Collaboration: Work closely within a highly matrixed, collaborative organization alongside clinical experts, product managers, and software engineers to ensure AI platforms operate safely and ground outputs in validated healthcare protocols.

  • Mentorship & Engineering Excellence: Foster a culture of technical rigor by setting high coding standards, leading design reviews, standardizing tooling, and mentoring other ML and software engineers across the team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of practical software development experience with a heavy emphasis on product design, core system architecture, and shipping scalable software platforms (or 2+ years of post-PhD industry experience in a dedicated AI research/engineering role).

  • Advanced programming proficiency in Python and deep hands-on expertise with distributed machine learning or deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow).

  • Proven track record of architecting, implementing, and deploying complex LLM-powered applications, multi-agent orchestrations, or autonomous systems in a production environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative technical field.

  • 8+ years of industry experience specializing in advanced data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and heavy-duty scalable ML infrastructure.

  • 3+ years of technical leadership experience, including leading complex technical project workstreams, defining organizational engineering directions, or directly mentoring technical talent.

  • Experience working within complex, highly collaborative matrixed organizations on high-acuity, deeply regulated technical integrations (e.g., healthcare, fintech, or aerospace).

  • Research Excellence: A solid track record of contributions or publications at top-tier machine learning venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, KDD) with a specific focus on agentic frameworks, reinforcement learning, or data benchmark.

Salary and Benefits:

We offer competitive salary and benefits, including 401(k) matching, health, vision, and dental insurance, and very flexible paid time off.

The typical salary range for this role is $160,000 to $210,000 USD, depending on skills, qualifications, and relevant experience.

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Acting as a hands-on technical architect and strategic trailblazer, you will partner with key stakeholders to identify opportunities, translate ideas into actionable solutions, and deliver value through rapid proofs of concept. This role focuses heavily on designing, building, and scaling our next-generation cloud-native AI platforms, AI-powered log intelligence (AIOps), and semantic developer tooling.

Location: This is a hybrid position requiring a minimum of three days per week on-site at either our Lincolnshire, IL, or Holtsville, NY office.

  • Translate complex AI governance, cloud security guardrails, and regulatory requirements into practical technical specifications, partnering directly with systems engineers to integrate PII masking and RBAC into automated CI/CD pipelines.

  • Expertise in scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python) for automation or testing is a plus; software development background is welcomed.
  • Proven track record of deploying containerized AI solutions using Kubernetes (GKE/AKS), Docker, and robust CI/CD pipelines, backed by verifiable metrics such as high availability, latency reduction, and infrastructure cost optimization.

title: Geospatial Platform Lead
description:
Geospatial Platform Lead

Lynker Corporation is a leading provider of innovative solutions in weather and climate science. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for innovation, Lynker leverages cutting-edge technologies and scientific expertise to support the creation and delivery of improved operational weather forecasts. As part of our ongoing growth and expansion, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Geospatial Platform Lead to join our growing team.

Responsibilities

Duties of the Geospatial Platform Lead will include the following:

  • Platform architecture: own the architecture of the geospatial platform: cloud-native data (STAC, cloud-optimized formats), the serving and tiling layer (e.g., TiTiler), and the pipelines that scale model and map outputs.
  • Data at scale: translate science outputs into reliable, versioned data products and interfaces for applications, partners, and the public.
  • Standards & reliability: set engineering standards, including Infrastructure-as-Code on AWS; keep the platform reliable, secure, and interoperable; and own the roadmap for how it scales.
  • Cross-team alignment: share goals, schemas, and delivery patterns with the teams that produce our data and analytics so that products and platform interfaces line up.
  • Technical leadership: set technical direction for the cloud-native geospatial developers, coordinate across the Science, Applications, and Engineering teams, and mentor team members.
  • Delivery: keep the platform's data discoverable, reproducible, and operationally reliable for the applications, APIs, and partners that consume it.

Qualifications

The Geospatial Platform Lead selected should have the following:

  • Bachelor's or Master's in geospatial science, computer science, engineering, environmental or earth science, or a related field; or equivalent hands-on experience in place of a degree.
  • Several years building and operating cloud-native geospatial or data platforms (roughly 5+ years, or equivalent depth of experience).
  • Strong Python and production software practices, including Git, testing, and CI/CD.
  • Hands-on AWS experience (our primary cloud) and Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform or CloudFormation).
  • Experience with cloud-native geospatial formats and serving (COG, GeoParquet, STAC/pgSTAC, TiTiler, or comparable).

  • Deep experience with the STAC ecosystem and dynamic tiling (pgSTAC, stac-fastapi, TiTiler).
  • Distributed or large-scale processing (e.g., Dask, cloud batch) and high-performance computing.

What makes our team different is how we work: we operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for an AI Software Engineer with a strong software engineering background, a quick iteration mindset, and a passion for experimentation – balanced by a focus on shipping and scaling impactful features that deliver value to users. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to develop, test, and ship AI-powered features that contribute to improving infrastructure and observability quality through automation, while also expanding the capabilities of AI agents across the observability stack to assist users with incident response. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

Curious about what it's like to build AI at Grafana? Learn more about the team's philosophy, culture, and approach here.

What You’ll Be Doing:

title: Technical Instructor (EBEAM)
description:
Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division

The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. Preferred Qualifications

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Senior Network Engineer Global Network Services

Position Summary:

As a Senior Network Engineer within ADMs Global Technology organization, you will lead the design, governance, and transformation of enterprise LAN, routing, and switching solutions that form the backbone of ADMs global connectivity. This role blends deep technical expertise with strong leadership, executive communication, and financial stewardship. You will ensure ADMs enterprise networkspanning campus LANs, data center fabrics, WAN/SD-WAN, and firewallsdelivers high performance, resiliency, and security while directly enabling business outcomes. By defining robust architecture standards, optimizing routing protocols, advancing automation, and applying analytics-driven insights, you will ensure ADM achieves simplified, scalable, and reliable connectivity worldwide.

Key Responsibilities:

LAN, Routing & Switching Architecture:

  • Design, standardize, and govern ADMs global LAN and routing architectures, including data center switching, campus LAN, and site-level connectivity. Define resilient designs that leverage routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, and IS-IS to ensure deterministic, scalable, and secure traffic flows.
  • Produce reference architectures, detailed design templates, and technology roadmaps to guide enterprise-wide implementations. Provide executive-level communication to ensure alignment of technical standards with ADMs strategic priorities.

Routing Protocol Optimization & Standards:

  • Lead the development, optimization, and governance of enterprise-wide routing protocols, ensuring stability, convergence, and scalability across ADMs global footprint.
  • Drive adoption of best practices in route redistribution, summarization, path optimization, and high-availability design. Partner with operations teams to troubleshoot, tune, and optimize complex routing scenarios, ensuring predictable and resilient outcomes across LAN and WAN environments.

Technology Innovation & Business Alignment:

  • Evaluate and implement next-generation routing and switching technologies, working with key suppliers, including campus fabric designs, SD-Access, and advanced WAN/SD-WAN solutions.
  • Conduct proof of concept and pilots that demonstrate improved performance, resiliency, and cost efficiency. Prepare business cases supported by ROI, TCO, and operational impact analyses, ensuring that network investments align directly with ADMs enterprise strategies.

Solution Development, Testing & Certification:

  • Develop and certify network designs through rigorous testing of LAN, routing, and security capabilities. Create high- and low-level design documentation, test cases, and validation plans to ensure enterprise readiness.

Project Delivery & Execution Excellence:

  • Serve as the technical lead on PMO-driven and enterprise projects, ensuring LAN and routing requirements are captured, designs are validated, and risks are mitigated throughout the lifecycle.

Operational Expertise & Incident Leadership:

Together, the teams focus on prevention by embedding lessons learned into future designs, tuning routing protocols, optimizing LAN reliability, and automating routine tasks.

Automation, Analytics & Continuous Improvement:

  • Advance ADMs network maturity by introducing automation and analytics into LAN and routing environments. Implement configuration automation, monitoring dashboards, and data-driven analytics to ensure proactive detection of anomalies and optimization of routing behaviors.

Qualifications & Preferred Certifications:

  • 10+ years of enterprise network engineering experience, with strong expertise in LAN, routing, switching, and routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, IS-IS).
  • Bachelors degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong leadership, executive communication (written and verbal), and financial stewardship skills.

Desired Certifications:

  • Routing & Switching: Cisco CCNP/CCIE Enterprise (Routing & Switching focus), Juniper JNCIP/JNCIE
  • Security: CISSP, Cisco CCNP Security, Palo Alto PCNSE
  • Automation & Analytics: Cisco DevNet Professional, Python, Ansible, REST API integrations
  • Cloud & Emerging Tech: AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer Associate

Impact:

  • This position offers the opportunity to shape ADMs global network strategy with a strong emphasis on LAN, routing, and switching excellence. You will ensure deterministic routing, resilient campus and data center connectivity, and secure integration with WAN and cloud networks.
  • By combining technical depth with leadership and innovation, you will drive both operational stability and business agility across ADMs worldwide network.

Cisco Campus LAN Switching & Routing Catalyst 9K platform, Branch / WAN Edge & SD-WAN Catalyst 8K platform, ASR, ISR, vEdge, Data Center Switching & Fabric Nexus 9000 platform, APIC, Nexus Dashboard, F5 BIG-IP, NetScaler, Wireless 9800 Controllers, Cisco Firepower, Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), DNA Center, Cisco vManage, vBond, vSmart, Cisco ThousandEyes, and Stealthwatch

description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. THE ROLE:

AMD NBIO (North Bridge IO) team delivers industry leading high-performance interconnects IP for all AMD products including dGPU, Machine Learning, APU, Server and Game consoles. NBIO global operates seamless from China, North America and Europe.

IOHUB sits in the center of all data paths, it includes 2 foundation IP (name as IOHub Core and IOMMU) and one IOHUB Subsystem. IOhub Core is the PCI “host bridge” of the system which provides decoding and routing services to PCIe etc. devices. IOMMU (I/O Memory Management Unit) is responsible for address translation and memory protection, it plays a critical role on IO virtualization technology which is widely used in mega-data center.

We are searching for a lead for IOHUB Subsystem verification and Project execution.



THE PERSON:

A successful candidate will work with senior silicon design engineers. The candidate will be highly accurate and detail-oriented, possessing good communication and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong team spirit
  • Drive to completion
  • Fluent verbal English

  • IOHUB Subsystem verification strategy and scoping

  • Closely work with Design/Architecture team to develop new verification components
  • Organize/attend conference call for strategy alignment, status sync up etc. with global team
  • Short term global travel if needed


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Global company working experience background, fluent oral English
  • Complex IP/ASIC/SOC Design Verification, direct experience in IP/SOC or Processor (CPU or GPU) or Industry bus standard (PCI-e, HT) is preferred.
  • Good knowledge of UVM/Verilog/System C/System Verilog.
  • Solid background with hardware verification methodologies such as coverage-based verification methodology with the use of hardware assertions (PSL or SVA), insights into random techniques.
  • Experience of execution lead is an asset.

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.

Onni Capital invests its own capital. There is no fundraising cycle, no external investment committee, and no requirement to deploy on someone else's timeline. A good business can be pursued in days. A weak one can be declined without ceremony.

Permanent capital changes the conversation with a founder. We are not pitching a three year flip. When an owner cares where their company and their people end up, that is a real advantage and you will feel it in live negotiations.

Onni's operating businesses give genuine diligence advantage. When evaluating a construction services or industrial business, we test assumptions against companies we already own and operators we already work with, rather than relying on a consultant's market study.

You will also have unusual proximity to decision makers. There is no chain of vice presidents between you and the people approving capital.

How We Work

Onni Capital is being designed as a high ownership, low bureaucracy team. We work in small project groups, test ideas quickly, put early products in front of users, and make decisions based on evidence rather than hierarchy. Team members are expected to:

  • Challenge assumptions and communicate directly
  • Take responsibility for outcomes, not simply produce recommendations
  • Use modern AI tools to work faster and produce better results
  • Share unfinished work early and improve it through feedback
  • Move comfortably between strategic analysis and hands on execution
  • Know when to continue investing in an idea and when to stop
  • Operate effectively without a detailed playbook

This is not a role for someone who wants months of consensus building, a rigid job description, or a narrowly defined set of responsibilities. It is for someone who learns quickly, takes initiative, enjoys solving ambiguous problems, and wants to help build something from the ground up.

What You Will Do

Sourcing and screening

  • Source acquisition opportunities directly through owner outreach, Onni's operating and industry network, trades contacts, supplier networks, and portfolio company management
  • Build and maintain relationships with brokers, advisors, lenders, and intermediaries in target sectors
  • Screen inbound and sourced opportunities against investment criteria and write the screening memo with a clear recommendation to pursue or pass
  • Develop sector theses and build target lists for roll up strategies across construction services, building products, industrial services, mechanical, HVAC, and adjacent trades

Execution

  • Own the operating and returns model on live transactions, including LBO structures, debt schedules, returns waterfalls, sensitivity analysis, and downside cases
  • Run due diligence across financial, commercial, operational, tax, and legal workstreams, and manage external advisors to scope, budget, and deadline
  • Lead the quality of earnings review with advisors, including EBITDA normalisation, working capital analysis, and net debt calculation
  • Structure transactions and financing, including consideration mix, earnouts, founder rollover, and lender terms
  • Draft and present investment committee memos and lender presentations, and defend the recommendation to ownership
  • Manage transaction execution, including the data room, issue tracking, legal documentation review, and coordination with counterparties through to close

After close

  • Own the first hundred days, including integration planning, reporting setup, banking, and management alignment
  • Track portfolio company performance against the acquisition thesis, including monthly performance, budget versus actual, covenant compliance, and integration milestones
  • Identify and quantify value creation opportunities across pricing, procurement, overhead, working capital, and add on acquisitions, then work with operators to execute them
  • Work with the Controller on purchase accounting, opening balance sheets, and post close true ups
  • Support add on acquisitions into existing platforms

Team and standards

  • Direct the private equity analysts on execution, review their work, and hold the quality standard
  • Build and maintain the deal flow tracker, pipeline reporting, and diligence templates so the process is repeatable rather than reinvented each time
  • Document processes, models, decisions, and operating standards so successful approaches can be repeated across the team
  • Contribute to internal investment discussions, portfolio reviews, and Onni Capital events

What You Bring

  • Three to six years in private equity, investment banking, corporate development, transaction advisory, or a comparable transaction environment, with live deals you can walk through in detail
  • Demonstrated ownership of a transaction, not only support. You have run workstreams, managed advisors, and been in the room when terms were negotiated
  • Strong modelling capability built from scratch rather than from templates, with real command of LBO mechanics, debt structures, and returns analysis
  • Sound accounting judgment, including EBITDA normalisation, quality of earnings, and working capital bridges
  • Genuine comfort in front of owners and management teams. Much of this job is a conversation with a person who built a business over thirty years and is deciding whether to trust you
  • Commercial judgment that connects operating detail to valuation, structure, and returns
  • Demonstrated ability to use modern AI tools to research, analyse, model, automate, and produce high quality work
  • Strong written communication, with the ability to compress a complex situation into a one page recommendation
  • Willingness to travel across North America, including Vancouver, Seattle, Los Angeles, Chicago, and Phoenix
  • A bias toward action and comfort making progress with incomplete information
  • The confidence to state a view and defend it while remaining open to evidence and feedback
  • Comfort working in a small, fast moving team where responsibilities change as deals develop
  • High personal standards for accuracy, quality, ownership, and follow through

Nice to Have

  • Experience in construction services, industrial services, manufacturing, building products, or trades businesses
  • Experience with buy and build or roll up strategies, including add on acquisition programmes
  • Experience with founder led businesses and owner operator transactions
  • Direct operating experience inside a portfolio company
  • CFA or CPA designation
  • Debt financing experience, including working directly with lenders and credit committees
  • Cross border transaction experience between Canada and the United States
  • Familiarity with tools such as Claude, Linear, Slack, or similar platforms

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured by deals looked at, models built, or memos written. It is measured by whether good businesses get bought at prices that work, and whether they perform afterwards.

Within the first 90 days:

  • You have direct relationships with owners, brokers, and advisors in at least one target sector, built rather than inherited
  • You are running live diligence workstreams and managing external advisors without supervision
  • The deal flow tracker and screening process are yours, and leadership can see the true state of the pipeline at any time
  • You have formed and defended a view on at least one live opportunity, including a recommendation to pass

Within the first year:

  • Proprietary opportunities are reaching us because of relationships you built, not only through brokers
  • You have taken at least one transaction from first contact through to close, owning the model, the diligence, and the recommendation
  • Owners and management teams take your calls and treat you as a credible counterparty rather than as a junior representative of the buyer
  • Diligence you ran caught something material, whether that led to a repriced deal or a decision to walk away
  • Businesses acquired during the year are reporting properly, integrated on plan, and tracking against the thesis you underwrote
  • At least one value creation initiative you identified has been executed by an operator and shows measurable results
  • The analysts you direct are producing work that needs less correction each quarter
  • Screening, diligence, and integration are running off documented process rather than being reinvented on every deal
  • Ownership treats your recommendation as the starting point for the decision rather than as one input among several

What Makes This Role Different

You will own a transaction from first contact through to whether the thesis actually held. On a single deal, you may be involved in:

  • Cold calling an owner who has never spoken to a buyer before
  • Building the model that determines what we are willing to pay
  • Sitting in the room while price and structure are negotiated
  • Running diligence and telling us to walk away
  • Testing commercial assumptions against businesses Onni already owns
  • Presenting the recommendation directly to ownership
  • Standing in the business the week after close, sorting out reporting and integration
  • Measuring, a year later, whether the numbers you put forward were right

The expectation is high ownership. You will be accountable for the deals you bring forward and for what happens to them afterwards.

The Onni Capital Experience

Onni Capital is creating a new headquarters in downtown Vancouver designed for builders, founders, investors, product teams, and portfolio companies, not traditional corporate administration. The space is intended to become a home for company creation, collaboration, product demonstrations, investment discussions, founder events, and the broader Onni Capital community.

Team members will receive:

  • Direct exposure to senior Onni executives, investors, operators, developers, and founders
  • The opportunity to help launch products and businesses from the ground up
  • Access to Onni's operating businesses, technology resources, real estate portfolio, and investment platform
  • Competitive compensation and a discretionary performance bonus
  • A comprehensive company paid benefits package
  • An annual education and professional development allowance
  • Regular product demonstrations, founder sessions, investment discussions, and team events
  • Free access to a fully equipped gym
  • Friends and family rates across participating hospitality brands
  • Employee discounts at participating restaurants, retailers, fitness providers, and other businesses
  • A generous employee referral program

Salary Range:

$85,000

About The Company:

Onni

For over half a century, Onni has been building communities for people to live, work, and play. Our success reflects our commitment to our employees and partners, and our dedication to quality construction, innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction. Our expertise expands across North America, with offices in Vancouver, Toronto, Los Angeles, Seattle, Phoenix, and Chicago.

AI Use:

This role may involve the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support research, analysis, content development, design, reporting, or operational efficiency. Employees are expected to use AI responsibly and in compliance with company policies, data privacy requirements, confidentiality obligations, and applicable laws.

All AI-generated or AI-assisted outputs must be reviewed for accuracy, quality, and appropriateness before use. Employees are also expected to disclose when AI tools have been used in the creation of work and must not present AI-generated content as solely their own original work.

title: Senior Network Engineer - Security and WAN
description:
Senior Network Operations Engineer Global Network Services
Position Summary:
As a Senior Network Operations Engineer within ADMs Global Technology organization, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the operational stability, performance, and continuous improvement of ADMs global network infrastructure. This position focuses on operational excellence, ITSM process maturity, and effective management of Managed Service Providers (MSPs) responsible for day-to-day network support. You will help drive service reliability, proactive monitoring, and incident response, while ensuring network operations align with ADMs ITIL-based service management framework and Global Technology (GT) standards.
This role requires a balance of strong technical knowledge, process discipline, and supplier management expertise. You will partner closely with ADMs network engineering, architecture, and service management teams to maintain operational health, ensure SLA adherence, and drive continuous improvement through data-driven insights and automation.
Key Responsibilities:
Operational Excellence & Service Reliability:

  • Ensure the ongoing performance, availability, and resiliency of ADMs enterprise network, including LAN, WAN/SD-WAN, data center fabrics, firewalls, and wireless environments.
  • Oversee day-to-day network operations delivered through Managed Service Providers, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, OLAs, and operational KPIs.
  • Lead operational governance reviews and performance assessments with MSPs to identify gaps, drive accountability, and promote service improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure global network products and services maintain 24x7 service availability through effective monitoring, incident response, and escalation management.

ITSM Process Maturity & Governance:

  • Advance the maturity of ITSM processes within Network Operations, focusing on Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management.
  • Ensure compliance with ADMs ITIL-based processes and Global Technology governance standards (D2C & R2F).
  • Partner with Service Management L3 owners to enhance service reporting, trend analysis, and RCA quality.
  • Implement process improvements that reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to restore (MTTR), while improving service predictability.

Managed Service Provider (MSP) Oversight:

  • Act as ADMs operational interface for global network MSPs, ensuring technical and procedural alignment across incident, change, and service request workflows.
  • Manage service reviews, performance metrics, and operational escalations to ensure vendors meet contractual obligations.
  • Validate operational readiness for new solutions and ensure seamless handoff from project delivery into steady-state support.
  • Maintain governance documentation including runbooks, SOPs, and escalation matrices.

Continuous Improvement & Automation:

  • Drive operational automation and analytics initiatives to streamline network monitoring, event correlation, and fault isolation.
  • Develop dashboards and key health indicators to proactively identify risks and prevent outages.
  • Partner with engineering to integrate monitoring and telemetry into design standards, ensuring new deployments are operationally ready from day one.
  • Lead post-incident reviews to ensure lessons learned are embedded into operations and future designs.

Incident Leadership & Major Incident Management:

  • Serve as a senior technical resource during high-priority outages impacting global connectivity.
  • Lead cross-functional war rooms and coordinate with MSPs and internal teams for rapid resolution.
  • Conduct deep-dive problem investigations to identify root causes, corrective actions, and long-term preventive measures.
  • Champion a culture of accountability and continuous improvement through strong post-incident review discipline.Operational Readiness & Lifecycle Management
  • Ensure ADMs network devices, configurations, and software versions are current, supported, and aligned to lifecycle standards.
  • Support vulnerability remediation and security compliance activities in collaboration with the cybersecurity team.
  • Maintain configuration and asset data accuracy in ADMs CMDB and related tooling (e.g., SolarWinds, Cisco DNA Center, ServiceNow).
  • Drive proactive obsolescence management and risk mitigation for network infrastructure.

Qualifications & Preferred Certifications:

  • 810 years of enterprise network operations experience managing large, distributed networks.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL v4 practices and service management processes.
  • Proven experience managing or governing MSP-delivered network operations and performance SLAs.
  • Solid technical foundation across routing, switching, wireless, and network monitoring platforms.
  • Effective communicator, written & verbal capable of interacting with executives, peers, and suppliers. Understands how to relate to different level of an organization.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate operational data into actionable insights.

Desired Certifications:

  • Operations & ITSM: ITIL v4 Managing Professional or equivalent.
  • Networking: Cisco CCNP/CCIE Enterprise, CompTIA Network+, Juniper JNCIP.
  • Automation & Observability: Cisco DevNet Associate/Professional, Ansible, Python, or related scripting tools.
  • Cloud & Security: AWS/Azure Networking Associate, CCNP Security, Palo Alto PCNSE.

Languages:

  • English

Impact:
This position directly supports ADMs operational excellence objectives by ensuring a stable, secure, and predictable network foundation. You will drive measurable improvements in service reliability, incident response, and MSP performance, while strengthening ADMs ITSM maturity and alignment with Global Technology governance. Through disciplined operational leadership, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement, you will help ensure ADMs global connectivity remains resilient, efficient, and business-aligned.

Common Technologies Utilized at ADM
Cisco Catalyst 9K Campus LAN, Catalyst 8K SD-WAN, ASR/ISR Edge Routers, Nexus 9000 Data Center Fabric, Cisco DNA Center, ISE, vManage, Nexus Dashboard, Thousand Eyes, Stealthwatch, Citrix NetScaler, and SolarWinds Observability platforms.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems Sector has an opportunity for a Principal Systems Engineer with a primary focus on Interface Control Document (ICD) definition and management. The position is located on site in Rancho Bernardo, CA, El Segundo, California or Palmdale, CA.

The candidate should be a self-starter with familiarity working in an Integrated Product Team construct. The candidate will be responsible for performing analysis while working within an Integrated Product Team (IPT) structure to update and maintain a detailed set of software Interface Control Document (ICD) artifacts. The selected candidate will collaborate across engineering disciplines to integrate and communicate interface definition needs with internal stakeholders and external customers across multiple simultaneous Modernization and Sustainment efforts. This position will be in our Systems Engineering organization.

In this role, your primary roles and responsibilities will include:

  • Serve as the ICD lead engineer, owning definition, documentation, update, and configuration control of system and subsystem Interface Control Documents (ICDs).
  • Develop and maintain hardware, software, and data interfaces between internal subsystems and external stakeholders, ensuring consistency with system architecture and requirements.
  • Coordinate and lead interface working groups and technical interchange meetings to resolve interface issues and drive convergence across multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Use full knowledge of software and hardware disciplines to define and decompose interface from system-level requirements.
  • Perform Systems Engineering activities, such as functional analysis, interface definition, and verification.
  • Work on Agile programs and methodology using Jira, including backlog refinement of interface-related tasks and stories.
  • Interface and present to program leadership and/or customers using strong written and oral communication skills, including status of ICD maturity, risks, and impacts.

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility. There is no remote / hybrid / telework available for this position.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline and 5 years of related engineering experience; OR a Master’s Degree in a STEM discipline and 3 years of related engineering experience; OR a PhD in a STEM discipline and 1 year of related engineering experience.
  • Active USG Top Secret SCI clearance (with a background investigation within the past 5 years or enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).
  • Ability to obtain and maintain initial Special Program Access (SAP/PAR). This SAP/PAR must be obtained prior to commencement of employment and must be obtained within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the company to meet its business needs.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain subsequent SAP PARs following commencement of employment to be able to completely support statement of work.
  • Experience in DOORS, XML tooling (e.g., XSD editors, XML validators), Atlassian Tool Suite.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to work in a dynamic, fast paced environment, Action Oriented, Strong Attention to Detail, Communicates Effectively.
  • Programming Skills in C/C++/Python/VBA including experience generating, parsing, and validating XML.
  • Current applicable Special Access Program (SAP) clearance.
  • Demonstrated communication and technical writing skills.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in analytical thinking and problem-solving skills and Systems Thinking mindset.
  • Proven ability to brief technical presentations to stakeholders.
  • Experience with Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) concepts and tools (CAMEO).

Primary Level Salary Range: $114,000.00 - $171,000.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

title: Clinician Unlicensed- Respite
description:
Behavioral Health Network (BHN) is a leading statewide provider of behavioral health services and a Certified Great Place to Work. Since 1938, BHN has helped individuals, families, and communities thrive through compassionate, high-quality care and support. With deep roots in Western Massachusetts and a growing presence in communities throughout the state, we are currently seeking a Clinician Unlicensed to join our Adult Community Crisis Stabilization (A-CCS) team and help advance our mission of empowering people to live healthier, more fulfilling lives.

What We Offer:

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Make a meaningful impact in the lives of individuals, families, and communities throughout Western Massachusetts.
  • Professional Growth – Access ongoing training, mentorship, career development, and advancement opportunities across one of the region's largest behavioral health organizations.
  • Supportive Team Culture – Join a collaborative workplace guided by our HEART values: Humanity, Empowerment, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork.
  • Stability & Opportunity – Build your career with a well-established organization serving Western Massachusetts since 1938.
  • Comprehensive Benefits – Generous PTO, 403(b), educational assistance, medical, dental, vision, employee assistance programs, and more.
  • Certified Great Place to Work – Work for an organization recognized for creating a positive and engaging employee experience.

What You Will Do:

  • Provide high-quality, community-based clinical and consultative services to individuals receiving care through Adult Community Crisis Stabilization (A-CCS), as well as their families, program staff, and collaborating providers.
  • Complete intakes and comprehensive clinical assessments, including risk assessment, diagnosis, mental-status evaluation, social functioning, and evidence-based screening tools.
  • Develop and document individualized action plans, safety plans, treatment plans, and other clinical interventions in partnership with individuals, significant supports, and the multidisciplinary team.
  • Determine and implement appropriate treatment and referral responses based on clinical assessment, using the least restrictive and most person-centered alternatives available.
  • Lead treatment and disposition planning during assigned shifts, participate in daily case meetings, and consult regularly with supervisors, program staff, collateral providers, and community partners.
  • Develop comprehensive discharge and aftercare plans, complete discharge summaries, and coordinate referrals that support continuity of care and successful transition back to the community.
  • Facilitate psychoeducational, recovery-oriented, and behavioral health groups appropriate to the A-CCS level of care and provide education to individuals, groups, and staff.
  • Triage daily clinical workflow, support appropriate program census and admissions, oversee treatment planning during the shift, and help maintain a safe, therapeutic, and organized milieu.
  • Complete clear, accurate, and timely electronic documentation of assessments, treatment, progress, consultations, dispositions, and other required clinical and operational information.
  • Participate in individual and group supervision, training, seminars, quality-improvement activities, and data collection; serve as a liaison with Emergency Services and other providers; and perform other assigned duties.

Who You Are:

  • Master’s degree in a clinical behavioral health or related clinical program required.
  • Experience using a variety of evidence-informed treatment approaches with individuals experiencing behavioral health challenges; crisis-stabilization or inpatient experience preferred.
  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnosis, risk-assessment, safety-planning, treatment-planning, discharge-planning, and referral skills.
  • Ability to establish rapport with individuals experiencing psychiatric symptoms, their families and significant supports, and collaborating providers while maintaining professional boundaries and confidentiality.
  • Excellent observation, critical-thinking, clinical judgment, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to manage complex clinical dilemmas through team consultation.
  • Strong group-facilitation, conflict-management, education, verbal communication, and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organization, workflow management, documentation, teamwork, and technology skills, with the ability to remain effective as clinical conditions and priorities change.
  • Commitment to culturally responsive, recovery-oriented, person-centered care and motivation to work with individuals experiencing acute behavioral health needs.
  • Ability to work the assigned essential-staff schedule and meet the physical requirements of the role, including standing, walking, and lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling up to 20 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

We Hire for HEART!

Since 1938, BHN has delivered high-quality, culturally responsive behavioral health care, building deep roots in Western Massachusetts while expanding our impact in communities throughout the state. Our core values—Humanity, Empowerment, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork—guide how we lead, serve, and support one another. If you’re ready to bring your skills and experience to a mission-driven organization where your work can make a meaningful difference, we’d love to hear from you.

Salary Range: $55,000-$72,000

title: Salesforce Technical Architect
description:
Salesforce Technical Architect

Location: Dallas or Houston, TX

We are seeking a senior, client-facing Salesforce Technical Architect who has grown from a hands-on Salesforce Developer into a technical leader, development manager, or architect. This person will own end-to-end technical solution design, lead delivery teams, and remain capable of diving into code, integrations, troubleshooting, and platform decisions when required.
The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at both the strategic and delivery levels: advising clients and executives, translating business priorities into scalable Salesforce architecture, guiding developers and admins, and ensuring high-quality implementation across the lifecycle. Salesforce Technical Architects are expected to design secure, high-performing, integrated solutions within the client’s broader technology.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, estimation, and delivery for complex Salesforce engagements.
  • Partner directly with client business and technology stakeholders to understand goals, constraints, processes, data, and enterprise architecture.
  • Translate functional requirements into scalable Salesforce technical designs, including architecture diagrams, data models, integration specifications, security models, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Serve as the technical authority for Salesforce platform design, custom development, integrations, data migration, release strategy, performance, and security.
  • Lead, mentor, and guide Salesforce developers, administrators, QA resources, and technical leads; conduct design and code reviews and establish engineering standards.
  • Remain hands-on as needed with Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, APIs, integrations, debugging, and complex production issue resolution.
  • Design and govern integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms using APIs, middleware, event-driven patterns, and appropriate synchronous/asynchronous processing.
  • Define architecture and development standards for scalability, maintainability, testability, security, CI/CD, source control, and environment management.
  • Evaluate Salesforce capabilities and recommend the appropriate mix of configuration, declarative automation, custom development, AppExchange solutions, and external services.
  • Lead technical workstreams across full project lifecycles: discovery, design, build, test, deployment, hypercare, and ongoing optimization.
  • Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, dependencies, estimates, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical client audiences.
  • Support pre-sales activities as needed, including solutioning, technical demos, estimation, statements of work, and client presentations.
Technical Architects commonly lead custom Apex/LWC development, API and integration design, large-data-volume considerations, environment strategy, and DevOps processes.

Required Qualifications
  • 8+ years of Salesforce experience, including a clear progression from Salesforce Developer or Senior Developer into Technical Lead, Development Manager, Technical Architect, or equivalent senior consulting role.
  • 3+ years leading technical teams, delivery workstreams, or major Salesforce implementation programs.
  • Strong hands-on development experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce where applicable, SOQL/SOSL, asynchronous Apex, REST/SOAP APIs, and Salesforce DX.
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce security, sharing, role hierarchy, permission sets, profiles, identity/access considerations, and governance.
  • Demonstrated experience designing enterprise integrations, data migration approaches, API strategies, and error-handling/reconciliation processes.
  • Experience with CI/CD, version control, automated testing, code quality practices, release management, and multi-environment deployment strategies.
  • Proven ability to design for scale, performance, system limits, large data volumes, maintainability, and operational support.
  • Consulting experience with direct client interaction, stakeholder management, technical workshops, requirements clarification, and executive-level communication.
  • Experience leading distributed or cross-functional teams while balancing hands-on technical contribution with architecture and delivery leadership.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical choices and trade-offs in business terms.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect, System Architect, Integration Architect, Data Architect, Sharing & Visibility Architect, or Salesforce Certified Technical Architect.
  • Experience with Salesforce clouds such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Field Service, Marketing Cloud, CPQ/Revenue Cloud, or Financial Services Cloud.
  • Experience with MuleSoft or comparable middleware/iPaaS platforms.
  • Background in Agile delivery, technical project estimation, enterprise architecture, and managed services/support environments.
  • Experience with modern web technologies such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, or external cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Prior experience in a consulting firm, Salesforce partner, systems integrator, or client-facing delivery organization.

title: Program Manager
description:
Program Manager (Leamington Region)

Location: Remote

At IUNU (“you knew”), we're amplifying the ability of growers to produce the highest quality greenhouse crops by leveraging robotics, computer vision, and AI. Our LUNA AI system is deployed at greenhouses in more than 18 countries, providing critical information like yield forecasts, pest detection and germination rates to growers on mobile and web platforms. By increasing yield and reducing waste, we're building a sustainable future full of delicious vegetables.

Responsibilities:
We are looking for a greenhouse professional to join our Customer Success Team. This is a unique opportunity to bridge the gap between Leamington’s greenhouses and our global technology team across North America and the EU.

We need someone who understands the daily reality of Propagators and Vegetable growers (Tomatoes, Peppers, Cucumbers) but wants to pivot their career into high-tech. You will be our boots-on-the-ground partner, ensuring our customers get massive value from our AI and Robotics platform.

Your Primary Focus: Building Value
You will spend your days visiting 2–3 customers in the Southern Ontario region. Your main goal is ensuring the customer is happy and the technology is being used effectively.
  • Rapport Building: ability to easily build rapport with stakeholders across an organization that drives trust
  • Adoption & Training: Teach Head Growers and labour teams how to use our software. Help them understand the data so they can make better decisions.
  • Documenting the Wins: Work with the customer to track the "wins." Did we save them labour hours? Did we improve yield accuracy? You will document this value to help us prove our worth.
  • Success Planning: Work with our global CS leadership to execute success plans that align with the grower’s crop cycles.

The "Field" Aspect (The Hybrid Skillset)
Because our software lives on physical robots in the greenhouse, this is not a desk job. We need someone who is tech-savvy and not afraid to get their hands dirty.
  • The "Get it Done" Factor: While your main job is value, you must be willing to jump in when the situation requires hands-on attention. If a robot needs a reset, a sensor needs cleaning, or you need to climb a gantry to check a connection, you are ready to do it.
  • Technical Comfort: You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable adopting new tools and learning basic hardware troubleshooting to keep the customer running.

About You:
  • Greenhouse Veteran: You have 5 years of experience in the industry. You know the difference between a bad crop day and a bad tech day.
  • Collaborative Communicator: You can explain complex greenhouse issues to a software developers in North America, Europe, and complex software issues to a grower in Leamington.
  • Tech-Ready: You use technology in your personal life and pick up new software quickly. (Linux experience is a "nice to have," but an open mind is a "must have").
  • Local & Mobile: You are based in Southern Ontario and willing to drive to local sites daily.
  • AI-Optimist: You understand that Computer Vision and AI Agents aren't here to replace growers. They are here to give them superpowers. You are comfortable working with systems that "see" and "act" (like automated scouting or yield forecasting) and can explain to a skeptical grower why the data is trustworthy.

Requirements:
  • 2-year College or University Degree
  • Experience: 5–8 Years in Greenhouse Industry
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical capabilities
  • Ability to understand and translate customer business needs into actionable plans
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Proven track record of improving customer satisfaction, retention, or adoption
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, dynamic, and ambiguous environments
  • Able to spend up to 70% of your time in the field
Note: this is a remote job

Diversity
At IUNU, we’re committed to providing a safe and inclusive environment. We are dedicated to the happiness and success of all of our employees, and strive to foster a workplace in which individual differences are recognized, appreciated, nurtured, and respected. Diversity is important, and we strongly encourage people of all identities and backgrounds to confidently apply for a job with us if this is a role that interests and excites you. We want you to feel comfortable bringing your whole self to work with you, with all of your talents and strengths.

title: Data Engineer, Senior

Ever-expanding technology like IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence means that there’s more structured and unstructured data available today than ever before. As a data engineer, you know that organizing data can yield pivotal insights when it’s gathered from disparate sources. We need an experienced data engineer like you to help our clients find answers in their data to impact important missions, from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence.

As a data engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll help build advanced technology solutions and implement data engineering activities on some of the most mission-driven projects in the industry. You’ll deploy and develop pipelines and platforms that organize and make disparate data meaningful.

Here, you’ll work with and guide a multi-disciplinary team of analysts, data engineers, developers, and data consumers in a fast-paced, agile environment. You’ll use your experience in analytical exploration and data examination while you manage the assessment, design, building, and maintenance of scalable platforms for your clients.

Work with us to use data for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience creating software for retrieving, parsing, and processing structured and unstructured data

  • 3+ years of experience with Python, SQL, Scala, or Java

  • 3+ years of experience building scalable ETL/ELT workflows for reporting and analytics

  • Experience using version control tools, such as GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket

  • Experience creating solutions within a collaborative and cross-functional team environment

  • TS/SCI clearance

title: Head of Data & AI Product Excellence - all genders
description:
About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

About the job

As Head of Data & AI Product Excellence within our Data & AI team, you'll define how Sanofi — and every Sanofi employee — steps into the AI-driven future: working with AI, not just being served by it. Ready to get started?

Join the digital engine driving Sanofi's transformation — where AI, automation, and bold experimentation power faster science and smarter decisions. Here, you'll help build the first biopharma company powered by AI at scale.

This is a role for a senior leader who thinks in ecosystems. You'll own the strategy and execution of Sanofi's agentic AI landscape — ensuring that capabilities built anywhere in the organisation are shared everywhere, and that no team reinvents what already exists. From the Document Factory to the GenAI & AI Agent Hub, you'll steward the flagship platforms that make AI real for thousands of colleagues across R&D, commercial, manufacturing, and beyond.

But this role is about more than platforms. It's about preparing people for what's next — scanning the AI horizon, translating emerging signals into strategic bets, and ensuring Sanofi leads rather than follows in the age of intelligent, agentic AI.

In this role you will . . .

  • . . . define and lead Sanofi's enterprise strategy for agentic AI, ensuring every team builds on a shared, governed foundation rather than creating isolated solutions.
  • . . . own the full lifecycle of reusable AI and data components — so proven capabilities are built once and scaled across the entire organisation.
  • . . . lead two flagship platforms — Document Factory and the GenAI & AI Agent Hub — driving adoption, measuring impact, and continuously raising the bar on performance and user experience.
  • . . . partner with Data & AI leaders across all business verticals to identify duplication early and guide teams toward smarter, shared investment.
  • . . . stay ahead of the AI curve — tracking emerging technologies, running rapid proof-of-concepts, and translating new advances into concrete opportunities before competitors do.
  • . . . collaborate with senior leadership to align priorities, govern shared investment, and ensure all platforms meet the highest standards for security, compliance, and responsible AI.

About you

The criteria below reflect what would help someone thrive in this role. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every point — we value diverse experiences and perspectives.

  • Educational background in Engineering, Data, AI, or a related field with an advanced university degree.
  • Proven track record of leading data, AI, or digital product strategy at enterprise scale, with experience building and scaling shared platforms across complex organisations.
  • Deep knowledge of generative AI, agentic AI architectures, and modern data platforms — with a clear understanding of responsible AI practices and relevant regulatory frameworks.
  • A strategic thinker who can also execute - comfortable moving between vision-setting and hands-on delivery, and skilled at influencing senior stakeholders across functions.
  • Exceptional communicator - able to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for any audience, from engineers to executives.
  • Fluent English required.

Why choose us?

  • Own the most strategically significant AI role in Sanofi's digital transformation, with direct influence over how every business vertical builds and scales AI.
  • Shape the future of human-AI collaboration at one of the world's leading biopharma companies, empowering Sanofi's people to work with AI and not just alongside it.
  • Lead from Paris, at the heart of Sanofi's Digital Accelerator, partnering with senior leaders across R&D, Commercial, Manufacturing, and beyond.
  • Benefit from pioneering AI partnerships with OpenAI, AQEMIA, IBM, and others, and early access to the latest foundation models and agentic frameworks.
  • Join a workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core, with Employee Resource Groups and leadership programs that celebrate every voice.

Pursue progress, discover extraordinary

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn't happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let's be those people.

title: Data Steward
description:
Data Steward II

Location: Holtsville, New York

Remote Type: Hybrid Work

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Overview:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:

With ever-increasing demands for high-quality, reliable data to generate timely and effective business insights and data-driven decision-making, effective data stewardship is critical to success. The Zebra Data Steward is responsible for ensuring that data used by the organization is available when needed, well-defined, properly cataloged, scrupulously maintained, and continuously analyzed for trusted usability in business and customer-impacting analytics. The data steward is the ultimate custodian of data and plays a pivotal role in building trust in the data used for strategic and operational purposes, ensuring it meets the highest standards of integrity.

This role operates at the intersection between operational processes and data management, acting as the trusted authority in both operational data needs and in data governance best practices, including data quality assessment & assurance, metadata management, and data policy administration & oversight. Additionally, the advanced data steward is responsible for identifying, prioritizing and directly or indirectly executing data cleansing initiatives that rapidly remediate data deficiencies.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide authoritative business data stewardship over internal and external data, ensuring effective data management and alignment with overall business objectives.

  • Collaborate with operational teams to identify and document current and future data requirements and data use case scenarios.

  • Define and document data policies that establish standards and expectations for internal and external data, including descriptions, formats, structures, parameters, acquisition frequency & modality, etc.

  • Implement measures to safeguard data integrity and establish protocols for data validation and auditing; inspect and analyze existing and incoming data to identify disparities.

  • Identify root causes of data disparities; lead initiatives to improve data quality, accuracy, completeness, and timeliness in collaboration with IT.

  • Create and execute plans for data integrity improvements; communicate plans, progress and outcomes attained to stakeholders.

  • Generate and distribute reports and dashboards that provide insights into data quality and compliance.

  • Identify sources of repeat non-compliance with data standards, and drive corrective actions across people, process and technology dimensions.

  • Proactively communicate newly discovered data deficiencies to internal stakeholders, including operations, analytics, and IT teams.

  • Collaborate with IT and data engineering teams to optimize data storage, retrieval, and accessibility using appropriate technologies and tools.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including operational teams and IT, to identify optimal data acquisition strategies for externally sourced data, including system enhancements, data flow automation, automated inspections, etc.

  • Facilitate communication between data producers and consumers to ensure mutual understanding and effective use of data assets.

  • Ensure all data assets are properly recorded in Zebra’s enterprise data atlas tool; manage data dictionary & data lineage entries to maintain integrity of established semantic layer data models.

  • Establish and oversee a structured change management processes for data-related changes, ensuring impact assessment, stakeholder alignment, data atlas updates, approvals, and stakeholder communication.

  • Provide training and support to data users across the enterprise to enhance data literacy and promote best practices.

  • Act as the accountable point of contact for data-related inquiries and issues, offering solutions and guidance as needed.

  • Train and mentor lower-level data stewards.

This is a hybrid position (3 days/week in office) located in the Holtsville, NY location.

This position is expected to start in 2027.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred or equivalent experience; preferably in Data Management, Information Systems/Information Technology, Data Analytics, Data Science, or other data-oriented operational fields, such as supply chain, finance, etc.

  • 3+ years of proven professional/academic experience in data stewardship, master data governance, data management, data science, or data analytics

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Successful completion of a Zebra Technologies Internship

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail

  • Solid understanding of relevant operational processes and corresponding data requirements

  • Ability to perform data analysis and build data visualization using tools such as PBI, Tableau, MS Excel, etc.

  • Ability to synthesize complex data-related issues and convey insights clearly and concisely to technical and business stakeholders

  • Deep knowledge of data lineage, digital data validation & remediation techniques

  • Demonstrated initiative in improving data management processes and systems

  • Proven experience with data cleansing; ability to identify and correct data errors or discrepancies

  • Demonstrated proficiency with digital data catalog and data governance systems; experience with Alation preferred

  • Understanding of Conceptual, Logical, and Physical data models and their application

  • Ability to work autonomously and lead initiatives that deliver high-impact outcomes

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across diverse teams

  • Familiarity with relevant operational systems used in assigned domain area

  • Prior experience managing outsourced services preferred

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability and protected veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law. title: American Sign Language Interpreter ASL
description:
American Sign Language Interpreter (ASL) – School-Based

Pulaski, TN | Full-Time | 2026–2027 School Year | On-Site

About Us

TheraPeds Partners is a therapist-owned and operated organization. We partner with schools to provide Special Education services to students nationwide. As a team of special education providers, we understand the education process, IDEA requirements, and the importance of collaboration within multidisciplinary teams. Our mission is to deliver high-quality services while making meaningful connections in a collaborative learning environment.

TheraPeds Partners is seeking a skilled and dedicated American Sign Language Interpreter (ASL) to join our team for a full-time, school-based opportunity in Pulaski, Tennessee for the 2026–2027 school year.

If you're passionate about ensuring Deaf and Hard of Hearing students have meaningful access to classroom instruction, communication, and participation throughout their school day, this could be a great fit. You'll work collaboratively with students, teachers, special education teams, and related-service professionals, with support from both the school district and the TheraPeds team.

Position Details

  • Full-time: Approximately 38-40 hours per week
  • School year: 2026–2027, August through May/June
  • Location: Pulaski, TN
  • Setting: On-site, in-person
  • Pay: $45–$55/hour, based on qualifications, certification, experience, and employment arrangement
  • Weekly compensation: Approximately up to $2,100+, based on a 40-hour workweek
  • Guaranteed hours, including designated planning, collaboration, and administrative time as applicable
  • Support from both the school district and TheraPeds Partners

What You'll Do

As a school-based ASL Interpreter, you'll provide communication access for Deaf and Hard of Hearing students throughout the educational environment. You'll interpret spoken English into American Sign Language and ASL into spoken English while maintaining the meaning, intent, tone, and context of communication.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Providing accurate and effective ASL-English interpretation during classroom instruction, discussions, and school activities
  • Interpreting communication between students, teachers, peers, administrators, related-service providers, and other school personnel
  • Supporting students' access to academic instruction, classroom discussions, group activities, assemblies, field trips, and other school-sponsored activities
  • Demonstrating strong receptive and expressive ASL skills and accurately interpreting classroom instruction and student interactions
  • Facilitating communication while maintaining the student's independence and appropriate professional interpreter boundaries
  • Adapting interpreting strategies to the student's age, language level, communication needs, and educational environment
  • Preparing for classroom content and becoming familiar with curriculum-specific terminology to support accurate interpretation
  • Collaborating with Teachers of the Deaf and Hard of Hearing, special education teachers, general education teachers, related-service providers, and other members of the educational team
  • Supporting implementation of communication accommodations and services identified in students' Individualized Education Programs (IEPs)
  • Participating in educational team meetings and IEP meetings when appropriate to the interpreter's assigned role
  • Maintaining confidentiality and protecting student information in accordance with district policies and applicable state and federal requirements
  • Following professional interpreting standards and ethical practices
  • Communicating effectively with educational teams regarding interpreting and communication-access needs while remaining within the interpreter's professional role
  • Supporting students across a variety of school environments and throughout the school day

Requirements

What We're Looking For

    • Fluency in American Sign Language (ASL) and English, with strong receptive and expressive communication skills
    • Educational Interpreter Performance Assessment (EIPA) score of 3.5 or higher, as applicable to Tennessee requirements
    • Successful completion of required written assessment/testing, as applicable
    • Required documentation submitted to the Tennessee Department of Education, as applicable
    • Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf (RID) certification preferred
    • Completion of an Interpreter Training Program (ITP) or ASL-English interpreting program preferred
    • Associate or bachelor's degree preferred
    • Previous experience interpreting in K–12 educational settings strongly preferred
    • Ability to accurately interpret academic instruction, classroom discussions, student interactions, and school-related communication
    • Understanding of the interpreter's role within an educational setting and the ability to maintain appropriate professional boundaries
    • Knowledge of IDEA, IEP processes, special education services, and educational accommodations
    • Understanding of Deaf culture and communication access within educational environments
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with Deaf and Hard of Hearing students, teachers, families, administrators, and multidisciplinary teams
    • Ability to support students throughout the school day and across multiple educational environments
